好，我们先把“机器可读蓝皮书”这件事做实——
下面这一整段你可以直接存成 quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml，作为权威蓝皮书 spec v1。

设计原则：

覆盖蓝皮书所有要点，每个大块都落在：layers / environments / memory_fabric / loops / capabilities / governance / experiments / phases / challenges 里。

全部机器可读：键一律英文，值可以中英混合描述；后面你可以用 Python 直接 parse。

后续 BlueprintGapTracker 就是按这里的 capabilities.*.components 和 requirements 来对照“实现 vs 占位 vs 缺失”。

blueprint:
  id: "meta_agent_v3"
  codename: "Project Quentin"
  version: "3.0"
  edition: "Research-Integrated"
  description: >
    Meta-Agent v3: a research-integrated, self-evolving AI operating system
    with continual memory, self-programming, and experiment-friendly design.
    元目标：在安全边界和可回滚前提下，让智能体在多领域中持续学习 / 自演化 / 自改代码。

  goals:
    - id: g.continual_memory
      text: >
        Provide a continual, multi-tier memory system (STS/MTS/LTS) that can run long-term
        without stuffing all history into a single LLM context.
    - id: g.self_programming
      text: >
        Provide a self-programming engine that can generate code candidates, run tests,
        evaluate benefits/risks, and manage code patches under safety constraints.
    - id: g.research_friendly
      text: >
        Provide clear experiment interfaces for all main loops (cognitive / immune /
        sleep / skill&code evolution) with well-defined inputs/outputs/metrics, so new
        algorithms can be plugged in and compared.

  non_goals:
    - id: ng.full_autonomy_without_oversight
      text: "Do NOT pursue a fully unsupervised system without any governance or kill switch."
    - id: ng.modify_kernel_schema
      text: "AI must NOT modify the safety kernel or core schema definitions at runtime."
    - id: ng.solve_all_research
      text: "Do NOT aim to solve multi-agent game theory or full architecture search in v3."

  design_principles:
    - "trace_everything: 无 Trace 不执行"
    - "kernel_vs_mutable: 安全内核与可自改模块严格分区"
    - "sandbox_first: 所有自演化实验从 sandbox 起步"
    - "governance_first: 所有自改决策经过 AI 治理层（多智能体 + 宪法）"

layers:
  - id: L0
    name: "Infra & Kernel Layer"
    description: "安全内核 / 存储 / 运行时。不可由自编程引擎修改。"
    modules:
      - id: safety_kernel
        path: "quentin.kernel.safety.SafetyKernel"
      - id: storage_kv
        path: "quentin.infra.storage.kv_store.KVStore"
      - id: runtime
        path: "quentin.runtime.agent_runtime.AgentRuntime"
    capabilities:
      - "kernel_safety"
      - "storage"
      - "runtime"

  - id: L1
    name: "Base Layer (Execution Layer)"
    description: "执行层：认知循环 / 记忆 / 技能 / 工具 / 模型路由。"
    modules:
      - id: cognitive_loop
        path: "quentin.cognitive.loop.CognitiveLoop"
      - id: planner
        path: "quentin.planning.planner.HierarchicalPlanner"
      - id: executor
        path: "quentin.execution.executor.Executor"
      - id: critic
        path: "quentin.critic.critic.Critic"
      - id: memory_fabric
        path: "quentin.memory.fabric.MemoryFabric"
      - id: trace_store
        path: "quentin.traces.episode_builder.TraceEpisodeBuilder"
      - id: skill_library
        path: "quentin.skills.library.SkillLibrary"
      - id: skill_miner
        path: "quentin.skills.miner.SkillMiner"
      - id: sleep_loop
        path: "quentin.sleep.loop.SleepLoop"
      - id: immune_loop
        path: "quentin.immune.loop.ImmuneLoop"
      - id: model_router
        path: "quentin.models.router.ModelRouter"
      - id: tool_manager
        path: "quentin.tools.manager.ToolManager"
    capabilities:
      - "cognitive_loop"
      - "memory_fabric"
      - "skill_evolution"
      - "immune_loop"
      - "sleep_loop"
      - "model_routing"
      - "tool_lifecycle"

  - id: L2
    name: "Meta Layer (Evaluation & Self-Improvement)"
    description: "评估、自改调度、多智能体协调层。"
    modules:
      - id: log_metrics_store
        path: "quentin.infra.logging.Tracer"
      - id: eval_harness
        path: "quentin.evaluation.harness.EvalHarness"
      - id: self_improvement_manager
        path: "quentin.self_programming.manager.SelfImprovementManager"
      - id: multi_agent_coordinator
        path: "quentin.agents.coordinator.MultiAgentCoordinator"
    capabilities:
      - "eval_harness"
      - "self_improvement"
      - "multi_agent"

  - id: L3
    name: "Research & Evolution Layer"
    description: "研究与演化策略层：实验编排 / 进化策略 / 资源预算 / 治理策略。"
    modules:
      - id: experiment_orchestrator
        path: "quentin.research.experiment_orchestrator.ExperimentOrchestrator"
      - id: evolution_strategy
        path: "quentin.research.evolution_strategy.EvolutionStrategyManager"
      - id: budget_controller
        path: "quentin.research.budget.BudgetController"
      - id: policy_engine
        path: "quentin.research.policy.PolicyEngine"
      - id: governance_council
        path: "quentin.governance.council.GovernanceCouncil"
      - id: constitution
        path: "quentin.governance.constitution.Constitution"
    capabilities:
      - "research_layer"
      - "evolution_strategy"
      - "budget_control"
      - "policy_governance"
      - "ai_governance_council"

environments:
  sandbox:
    description: "100% 实验环境，允许自编程自由试验。不可连接真实外部系统。"
    allowed_auto_patches: "all_mutable"
    risk_level: "low"
    traffic: "offline_or_simulated"
  staging:
    description: "小流量联机验证环境，用于验证 patch 在真实数据上的效果。"
    allowed_auto_patches: "governance_approved"
    risk_level: "medium"
    traffic: "shadow_or_canary"
  production:
    description: "正式生产环境，连接真实任务/系统。"
    allowed_auto_patches: "none_without_human_or_strict_policy"
    risk_level: "high"
    traffic: "real"
    constraints:
      - "no_auto_patch_without_governance_approval_and_policy_whitelist"
      - "no_mutation_of_kernel_or_schema"

memory_fabric:
  tiers:
    - id: STS
      name: "Short-Term Store"
      scope: "session_or_task_level"
      retention_hint: "minutes_to_hours"
    - id: MTS
      name: "Mid-Term Store"
      scope: "project_or_version_level"
      retention_hint: "days_to_weeks"
    - id: LTS
      name: "Long-Term Store"
      scope: "cross_project_knowledge"
      retention_hint: "weeks_to_years"

  record_schema:
    path: "quentin.memory.schemas.MemoryRecord"
    fields:
      - "id"
      - "tier"
      - "kind"          # episodic | semantic | procedural
      - "content"
      - "meta"
      - "importance"
      - "usage_count"
      - "update_policy"
      - "created_at"
      - "updated_at"

  update_policy:
    default:
      promotion_rule: "simple_usage_and_importance"   # 可被自定义算法替换
      decay_rule: "low_importance_and_low_usage"
      consolidation_batch: "nightly"
    notes: >
      实现上允许不同算法插拔，请求方只需满足：能在预算内对 MemoryRecord
      进行 tier 升降级 / 标记衰减。

loops:
  cognitive_loop:
    id: "loop.cognitive"
    description: "实时任务执行闭环。接任务 → 拆解计划 → 执行 → 反思 → 写记忆。"
    inputs:
      - "tasks from orchestrator"
      - "current context / memory hits"
    outputs:
      - "execution_trace_spans"
      - "execution_summary"
      - "lessons_learned"
      - "episodic_memory_entries"
    metrics:
      - "task_success_rate"
      - "avg_latency"
      - "avg_token_cost"
      - "error_rate"
    requirements:
      - id: cog.trace_required
        text: "每个步骤必须写 TraceSpan（无 Trace 不执行）"
      - id: cog.summary_required
        text: "任务结束必须生成 execution_summary"
      - id: cog.lessons_optional
        text: "lessons_learned 可选，但应支持 Critic 生成反思"

  immune_loop:
    id: "loop.immune"
    description: "异常检测与止损：监控错误 / 成本 / 延迟，触发降级与案例记录。"
    inputs:
      - "metrics_stream"
      - "observed_errors"
    outputs:
      - "immune_cases"
      - "degradation_actions"
      - "signals_for_research_layer"
    metrics:
      - "immune_cases_count"
      - "downgrade_events"
      - "recovery_time"
    requirements:
      - id: imm.anomaly_detection
        text: "实现至少一种异常检测逻辑（统计 or ML）"
      - id: imm.degradation_actions
        text: "支持自动降级（关闭自改 / 切回稳定版本）"
      - id: imm.case_packaging
        text: "异常期 Trace 打包成 ImmuneCase，供研究层分析"

  sleep_loop:
    id: "loop.sleep"
    description: "周期性巩固记忆 / 提取技能 / 生成训练数据。"
    inputs:
      - "trace_spans"
      - "memory_records"
      - "episodes"
    outputs:
      - "new_semantic_memory"
      - "new_procedural_memory"
      - "skill_candidates"
      - "training_pairs"
    metrics:
      - "episodes_processed"
      - "skills_mined"
      - "memory_promotions"
      - "memory_decays"
    requirements:
      - id: sleep.schedule
        text: "支持配置周期（daily / weekly / manual）"
      - id: sleep.budget
        text: "支持资源预算（最大处理 trace 数量 / token 上限）"
      - id: sleep.skill_output
        text: "输出可被 SkillLibrary 接受的 SkillDefinition 结构"

  skill_code_evolution_loop:
    id: "loop.skill_code_evolution"
    description: "技能与代码进化循环：从高质量 Trace 提炼技能、生成/替换代码。"
    inputs:
      - "high_success_traces"
      - "immune_flagged_modules"
    outputs:
      - "new_skills"
      - "skill_supersedes"
      - "code_patches"
      - "patch_reports"
    metrics:
      - "skills_generated"
      - "patches_proposed"
      - "patches_accepted"
      - "patches_rolled_back"
    requirements:
      - id: evol.pattern_mining
        text: "SkillMiner 应支持从 TraceEpisode 中抽象可重用模式"
      - id: evol.comparison
        text: "EvalHarness 应支持新旧技能/代码的对比评测"
      - id: evol.supersedes
        text: "对替换掉的技能/模块保留 supersedes 记录"

capabilities:
  memory_fabric:
    layer: "L1"
    category: "memory"
    description: "三层记忆系统 + 巩固 / 衰减 + 向量检索接口。"
    components:
      - "quentin.memory.schemas.MemoryRecord"
      - "quentin.memory.fabric.MemoryFabric"
    requirements:
      - id: mf.tiered_memory
        type: "functional"
        description: "支持 STS/MTS/LTS 三层记忆，记录 MemoryRecord.tier。"
      - id: mf.search_semantic
        type: "functional"
        description: "支持语义检索接口（可基于向量库或混合检索实现）。"
      - id: mf.consolidation_policy
        type: "functional"
        description: "支持插拔式巩固策略（Usage+Importance 等）。"
      - id: mf.cross_domain
        type: "functional"
        description: "MemoryRecord.meta.domain 支持 cross-domain 标记。"
      - id: mf.size_control
        type: "non_functional"
        description: "提供监控和限制，避免记忆库无节制膨胀。"
    metrics:
      - "mf.total_records"
      - "mf.records_by_tier"
      - "mf.hit_rate"
      - "mf.decay_events"
    definition_of_done:
      - "MemoryFabric 支持 STS/MTS/LTS tier，并能在 SleepLoop 中完成晋级/衰减。"
      - "search() 支持至少一种语义检索实现（不再仅限 substring）。"
      - "Observability 中可查看不同 tier 的规模与命中率。"

  cognitive_loop:
    layer: "L1"
    category: "loop"
    description: "认知循环：任务执行与即时反思。"
    components:
      - "quentin.cognitive.loop.CognitiveLoop"
      - "quentin.planning.planner.HierarchicalPlanner"
      - "quentin.execution.executor.Executor"
      - "quentin.critic.critic.Critic"
    requirements:
      - id: cog.plan_hierarchical
        type: "functional"
        description: "Planner 支持分层计划（子任务树），而非单步 plan。"
      - id: cog.memory_integration
        type: "functional"
        description: "任务执行前可从 MemoryFabric 检索相关记忆并注入上下文。"
      - id: cog.critic_reflexion
        type: "functional"
        description: "Critic 支持 LLM-based Reflexion，生成结构化错误分析。"
      - id: cog.trace_full
        type: "non_functional"
        description: "每个步骤都有 TraceSpan，TraceEpisodeBuilder 能重建执行轨迹。"
    metrics:
      - "cog.success_rate"
      - "cog.avg_steps_per_task"
      - "cog.retry_rate"
      - "cog.trace_spans_per_task"
    definition_of_done:
      - "CognitiveLoop 能在至少一个 demo 域上完成多步任务（含失败→重试）。"
      - "Critic 能基于 Trace 输出 lessons_learned 并写入 MemoryFabric。"

  immune_loop:
    layer: "L1"
    category: "loop"
    description: "免疫循环：异常检测与降级。"
    components:
      - "quentin.immune.schemas.ImmuneCase"
      - "quentin.immune.loop.ImmuneLoop"
    requirements:
      - id: imm.stats_detector
        type: "functional"
        description: "支持基于统计阈值的异常检测（error/cost/latency）。"
      - id: imm.degradation_mechanism
        type: "functional"
        description: "能触发降级动作：关闭自改、切回上一稳定策略等。"
      - id: imm.case_generation
        type: "functional"
        description: "能从异常期 Trace 生成 ImmuneCase 交 ResearchLayer 使用。"
    metrics:
      - "imm.anomaly_events"
      - "imm.degradation_actions"
      - "imm.recovery_time"
    definition_of_done:
      - "ImmuneLoop 能在简单基线下自动检测『异常高错误率』并触发降级。"

  sleep_loop:
    layer: "L1"
    category: "loop"
    description: "睡眠循环：记忆巩固 / 技能提炼 / 训练数据生成。"
    components:
      - "quentin.sleep.loop.SleepLoop"
      - "quentin.traces.episode_builder.TraceEpisodeBuilder"
      - "quentin.skills.miner.SkillMiner"
    requirements:
      - id: sleep.episodes_from_spans
        type: "functional"
        description: "支持从 TraceSpan 聚合成 TraceEpisode。"

BlueprintGapTracker 做的事就很清晰了：

按 capabilities.*.components 用 importlib 检查模块/类是否存在；

对比 requirements 构造 “implemented / placeholder / missing”；

给每个 capability 打一个 status 和 missing_requirements 列表。

后面你要做“蓝皮书自我迭代”的所有逻辑（任务生成、自编程、AI 审批），都可以直接挂在：

blueprint.capabilities（定义了要补齐什么）

phases（定义了推进顺序）

challenges（给 Research Layer 用来挑选优先研究方向）

如果你愿意，下一步我就直接帮你落地 BlueprintGapTracker.scan() 的 Python 骨架，用这份 YAML 做真实解析和 gap 输出。

一、整体设计：多 LLM 会议模式怎么长？
目标：
针对“重要/高风险/反复失败”的场景，不再让一个 LLM 单独决策，而是：

多模型各自给出方案（Proposal Round）

由一个或多个模型阅读所有方案，进行批判 + 合并（Critique & Merge Round）

产出一个最终共识方案 + 风险提示（Final Decision Round）

你可以把它理解成一个抽象接口：

result = council.deliberate(
    meeting_type="planning",  # 或 "reflection" / "debugging" / "patch_review"
    problem="我们要怎么实现 BlueprintGapTracker.scan() ?",
    context={...}
)
print(result.final_answer)
print(result.risks)
print(result.alternatives)
然后在：

Planner 做长计划

Critic 做深度反省

SelfProgrammingEngine 一直改不对的 patch

Blueprint 自迭代遇到棘手架构问题

都可以统一调用 council.deliberate(...) 来“开会”。

quentin/models/ollama_client.py

quentin/agents/multi_llm_roles.py

quentin/agents/multi_llm_council.py

三、Ollama 客户端封装
文件：quentin/models/ollama_client.py

# quentin/models/ollama_client.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

import requests

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class OllamaConfig:
    base_url: str = "http://localhost:11434"
    timeout: int = 120  # seconds


class OllamaClient:
    """
    统一封装 Ollama 的 /api/generate 接口。
    支持简单的单轮对话：把系统提示 + 会议上下文 + 问题拼成 prompt，让不同模型各自回答。
    """

    def __init__(self, config: Optional[OllamaConfig] = None) -> None:
        self.config = config or OllamaConfig()

    def generate(
        self,
        model: str,
        prompt: str,
        temperature: float = 0.3,
        max_tokens: int = 2048,
    ) -> str:
        """
        调用 Ollama /api/generate。
        注意：这里假设你本地 Ollama 支持 stream=false 一次性返回。
        """
        url = f"{self.config.base_url}/api/generate"
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": model,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "stream": False,
            "options": {
                "temperature": temperature,
                "num_predict": max_tokens,
            },
        }

        logger.debug("Calling Ollama: model=%s, prompt_len=%d", model, len(prompt))

        resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=self.config.timeout)
        resp.raise_for_status()

        data = resp.json()
        # Ollama /api/generate 返回形如 {"model": "...", "created_at": "...", "response": "...", ...}
        text = data.get("response", "")
        logger.debug("Ollama response (truncated): %s", text[:200])
        return text
说明：

现在只用 /api/generate 单轮调用，协议最稳定。

多轮对话我们自己在上层通过“拼接会议纪录文本”来实现，不依赖 /api/chat。

四、定义“参会 AI 角色”
文件：quentin/agents/multi_llm_roles.py

# quentin/agents/multi_llm_roles.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Literal, Dict, Any, List


MeetingType = Literal["planning", "reflection", "debugging", "patch_review", "generic"]


@dataclass
class LLMRoleConfig:
    """
    一个参会角色 = (使用哪个模型 + 扮演什么人格 + 对会议负责什么观点)
    """
    id: str
    name: str
    model: str
    purpose: str         # 用中文/英文描述角色职责
    style: str           # 风格说明：谨慎/发散/挑错/风险优先等
    default_temperature: float = 0.3
    weight: float = 1.0  # 在 vote/aggregation 中的权重


def default_roles_for_local_ollama() -> Dict[MeetingType, List[LLMRoleConfig]]:
    """
    针对你当前本地模型，预设几种会议组合：
    - planning: 规划/拆解任务
    - reflection: 复盘/反省
    - debugging: 调试/定位 bug
    - patch_review: 自编程 patch 审核
    """
    return {
        "planning": [
            LLMRoleConfig(
                id="planner_qwen_main",
                name="Qwen Planner",
                model="qwen3-vl:latest",
                purpose="给出结构化、分步骤、可执行的计划，偏严谨、清晰。",
                style="严谨、结构化、倾向分解任务而不是一步到位。",
                default_temperature=0.2,
                weight=1.2,
            ),
            LLMRoleConfig(
                id="deepseek_debater",
                name="DeepSeek Debater",
                model="deepseek-r1:1.5b",
                purpose="从不同角度提出问题、补充边缘情况，防止思路太保守。",
                style="发散、喜欢提出不同假设和可能的坑点。",
                default_temperature=0.4,
                weight=1.0,
            ),
            LLMRoleConfig(
                id="uncensored_skeptic",
                name="Uncensored Skeptic",
                model="my-deepseek-uncensored:latest",
                purpose="在安全边界内尽量提出『极端情况 / 反例 / 难点』，提醒风险。",
                style="爱挑毛病，优先指出可能失败之处。",
                default_temperature=0.5,
                weight=0.8,
            ),
        ],
        "reflection": [
            LLMRoleConfig(
                id="reflector_qwen",
                name="Qwen Reflector",
                model="qwen3-vl:latest",
                purpose="基于失败记录，做结构化复盘，抽象教训。",
                style="冷静分析，抽象原则和可迁移经验。",
                default_temperature=0.25,
                weight=1.2,
            ),
            LLMRoleConfig(
                id="deepseek_postmortem",
                name="DeepSeek Postmortem",
                model="deepseek-r1:1.5b",
                purpose="从过程层面挖掘『在哪里想偏了』『有哪些盲点』。",
                style="重过程，善于拆解推理路径。",
                default_temperature=0.4,
                weight=1.0,
            ),
        ],
        "debugging": [
            LLMRoleConfig(
                id="qwen_debugger",
                name="Qwen Debugger",
                model="qwen3-vl:latest",
                purpose="阅读报错/堆栈/代码片段，给出直接的修复建议。",
                style="实用主义，优先给出可运行的修改方案。",
                default_temperature=0.25,
                weight=1.2,
            ),
            LLMRoleConfig(

五、“多 AI 开会”核心类：MultiLLMCouncil
文件：quentin/agents/multi_llm_council.py

这个类做三件事：

第一轮：每个角色独立提出方案

第二轮：由一个“主持人模型”看完所有方案，做批判 + 合并

可选第三轮：让另一个模型对主持人方案做“风险复审”

# quentin/agents/multi_llm_council.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional

from quentin.models.ollama_client import OllamaClient
from quentin.agents.multi_llm_roles import (
    LLMRoleConfig,
    MeetingType,
    default_roles_for_local_ollama,
)


@dataclass
class Proposal:
    role_id: str
    role_name: str
    model: str
    content: str


@dataclass
class CouncilResult:
    meeting_type: MeetingType
    problem: str
    context: Dict[str, Any]
    proposals: List[Proposal]
    merged_answer: str
    risks: str
    notes: Dict[str, Any]


class MultiLLMCouncil:
    """
    多 LLM 会议模式：
    - 多个角色各自给出 proposal
    - 由一个主持人模型总结 + 合并 + 列出风险
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        client: Optional[OllamaClient] = None,
        roles_by_meeting: Optional[Dict[MeetingType, List[LLMRoleConfig]]] = None,
        moderator_model: str = "qwen3-vl:latest",
        reviewer_model: str = "deepseek-r1:1.5b",
    ) -> None:
        self.client = client or OllamaClient()
        self.roles_by_meeting = roles_by_meeting or default_roles_for_local_ollama()
        self.moderator_model = moderator_model
        self.reviewer_model = reviewer_model

    def _build_role_prompt(
        self,
        role: LLMRoleConfig,
        meeting_type: MeetingType,
        problem: str,
        context: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> str:
        """
        给单个角色的完整 prompt：
        - 角色职责 & 风格
        - 当前要解决的问题
        - 上下文（如：失败记录 / 相关限制）
        """
        context_str = ""
        if context:
            context_str = f"\n[Context]\n{self._format_context(context)}\n"

        return f"""You are participating in a multi-AI council.

[Your Role]
Name: {role.name}
Purpose: {role.purpose}
Style: {role.style}

[Meeting Type]
{meeting_type}

[Problem to solve]
{problem}
{context_str}

[Instruction]
1. Think independently, do not try to agree with other models (you will not see them).
2. Provide a clear, structured answer.
3. If you are unsure, say what you are unsure about and list assumptions.
4. Output in Chinese when user is Chinese, but keep structure very clear.

现在请根据你的角色给出你的完整建议。
"""

    @staticmethod
    def _format_context(context: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        # 简单地 json 化，后续可以更精细
        try:
            import json

            return json.dumps(context, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        except Exception:
            return str(context)

    def deliberate(
        self,
        meeting_type: MeetingType,
        problem: str,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> CouncilResult:
        """
        对外统一入口。
        1. 选出对应 MeetingType 的角色
        2. 每个角色独立生成 proposal
        3. 让主持人模型阅读所有 proposal 并合并 + 批判
        4. 让另一模型对主持人结果做风险复审（可选）
        """
        ctx = context or {}
        roles = self.roles_by_meeting.get(meeting_type) or self.roles_by_meeting["generic"]

        # 1) Proposal Round
        proposals: List[Proposal] = []
        for role in roles:
            prompt = self._build_role_prompt(role, meeting_type, problem, ctx)
            answer = self.client.generate(
                model=role.model,
                prompt=prompt,
                temperature=role.default_temperature,
            )
            proposals.append(
                Proposal(
                    role_id=role.id,
                    role_name=role.name,
                    model=role.model,
                    content=answer.strip(),
                )
            )

        # 2) Critique & Merge Round 由 moderator_model 负责
        merged_answer, risks, notes = self._moderate_and_merge(
            meeting_type=meeting_type,
            problem=problem,
            context=ctx,
            proposals=proposals,
        )

        return CouncilResult(
            meeting_type=meeting_type,
            problem=problem,
            context=ctx,
            proposals=proposals,
            merged_answer=merged_answer,
            risks=risks,
            notes=notes,
        )

    def _moderate_and_merge(
        self,
        meeting_type: MeetingType,
        problem: str,
        context: Dict[str, Any],
        proposals: List[Proposal],
    ) -> (str, str, Dict[str, Any]):
        """
        主持人模型：
        - 总结共识
        - 指出分歧
        - 给出综合方案
        - 列出风险 & TODO
        """
        proposals_text = ""
        for i, p in enumerate(proposals, start=1):
            proposals_text += f"\n=== Proposal {i} ({p.role_name} / {p.model}) ===\n{p.content}\n"

        context_str = self._format_context(context)

        moderator_prompt = f"""You are the moderator of a multi-AI council.

[Meeting Type]
{meeting_type}

[Problem]
{problem}

[Context]
{context_str}

[Proposals from different AI roles]
{proposals_text}

[Your task]
1. Summarize the common consensus across proposals.
2. Highlight key disagreements or conflicting assumptions.
3. Propose a merged, concrete plan or answer that:
   - is as safe and robust as possible
   - keeps useful diversity from different proposals
4. Explicitly list potential risks, uncertainties, or TODO items.
5. Answer in Chinese, with clear structure and headings.

请现在给出：
- 《综合方案》
- 《共识点》
- 《分歧与假设》
- 《风险与待确认事项》
"""

        merged = self.client.generate(
            model=self.moderator_model,
            prompt=moderator_prompt,
            temperature=0.25,
        )

        # 3) 可选：让 reviewer_model 做一次“风险复审”
        reviewer_prompt = f"""下面是一份由主持人总结的《综合方案》。

请你扮演「风险复审官」，任务是：
1. 找出此方案中可能存在的风险、遗漏和不合理假设。
2. 不要重复明显内容，重点补充新的视角。
3. 用简洁的要点形式列出。

《综合方案》如下：
{merged}
"""

        risks = self.client.generate(
            model=self.reviewer_model,
            prompt=reviewer_prompt,
            temperature=0.3,
        )

        notes: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "moderator_model": self.moderator_model,
            "reviewer_model": self.reviewer_model,
            "proposal_count": len(proposals),
        }
        return merged.strip(), risks.strip(), notes
这就是“多 AI 开会”最小 MVP：

多角色独立思考 → 主持人合并 → 风险复审

完全基于你本地的 Ollama 模型；

所有会议过程都可以被 Trace（后面你接 Tracer 即可）。

可以先在几个关键模块里加一个非常简单的触发逻辑（伪代码风格）：

一、文件结构设计

二、BlueprintSpec：加载 YAML 的封装
文件：quentin/blueprint/spec.py

# quentin/blueprint/spec.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import yaml

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class CapabilityRequirement:
    id: str
    type: str
    description: str


@dataclass
class CapabilitySpec:
    name: str
    layer: str
    category: str
    description: str
    components: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    requirements: List[CapabilityRequirement] = field(default_factory=list)
    metrics: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    definition_of_done: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class BlueprintSpec:
    id: str
    version: str
    codename: str
    raw: Dict[str, Any]
    capabilities: Dict[str, CapabilitySpec]

    @classmethod
    def load_from_file(cls, path: str | Path) -> BlueprintSpec:
        """
        从 meta_agent_v3.yaml 加载蓝皮书 spec。
        """
        path = Path(path)
        if not path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Blueprint spec file not found: {path}")

        with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data: Dict[str, Any] = yaml.safe_load(f)

        bp = data.get("blueprint", {})
        capabilities_data = data.get("capabilities", {})

        capabilities: Dict[str, CapabilitySpec] = {}
        for cap_name, cap_info in capabilities_data.items():
            reqs: List[CapabilityRequirement] = []
            for r in cap_info.get("requirements", []):
                reqs.append(
                    CapabilityRequirement(
                        id=str(r.get("id")),
                        type=str(r.get("type", "functional")),
                        description=str(r.get("description", "")),
                    )
                )

            capabilities[cap_name] = CapabilitySpec(
                name=cap_name,
                layer=str(cap_info.get("layer", "")),
                category=str(cap_info.get("category", "")),
                description=str(cap_info.get("description", "")),
                components=list(cap_info.get("components", [])),
                requirements=reqs,
                metrics=list(cap_info.get("metrics", [])),
                definition_of_done=list(cap_info.get("definition_of_done", [])),
            )

        return cls(
            id=str(bp.get("id", "meta_agent_v3")),
            version=str(bp.get("version", "0.0")),
            codename=str(bp.get("codename", "")),
            raw=data,
            capabilities=capabilities,
        )

    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
        return json.dumps(self.raw, ensure_ascii=False, indent=indent)
说明：

这段代码会把你刚才那整份 meta_agent_v3.yaml 全读进去，并且把 capabilities.* 转成结构化对象。

后面 BlueprintGapTracker 会直接用 BlueprintSpec.capabilities 来做检查。

三、BlueprintGapTracker：扫描实现 / 占位 / 缺失
文件：quentin/blueprint/tracker.py

# quentin/blueprint/tracker.py
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import inspect
import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from types import ModuleType
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from quentin.blueprint.spec import BlueprintSpec, CapabilitySpec

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ComponentStatus:
    component: str              # e.g. "quentin.memory.fabric.MemoryFabric"
    exists: bool
    is_placeholder: bool
    details: Dict[str, Any]


@dataclass
class CapabilityStatus:
    name: str                   # capability name, e.g. "memory_fabric"
    overall_status: str         # "implemented" | "placeholder" | "missing"
    components: List[ComponentStatus]
    missing_requirements: List[str]


class BlueprintGapTracker:
    """
    对照 meta_agent_v3 蓝皮书，检查当前代码库实现情况。
    输出每个 Capability 的状态：
    - implemented   : 所有组件存在，且至少有一部分非占位
    - placeholder   : 组件存在，但大部分是占位/空逻辑
    - missing       : 至少有一个关键组件不存在
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        blueprint: BlueprintSpec,
        placeholder_detection_enabled: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self.blueprint = blueprint
        self.placeholder_detection_enabled = placeholder_detection_enabled

    @classmethod
    def from_file(cls, path: str) -> "BlueprintGapTracker":
        bp = BlueprintSpec.load_from_file(path)
        return cls(blueprint=bp)

    # ---------- 外部主入口 ----------

    def scan(self) -> Dict[str, CapabilityStatus]:
        """
        扫描所有 capabilities，返回 {capability_name: CapabilityStatus}
        """
        results: Dict[str, CapabilityStatus] = {}

        for cap_name, cap_spec in self.blueprint.capabilities.items():
            try:
                cap_status = self._scan_single_capability(cap_spec)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception("Error scanning capability %s", cap_name)
                # 出错时，为了不让整个 scan 崩溃，标记为 missing，附上错误信息
                cap_status = CapabilityStatus(
                    name=cap_name,
                    overall_status="missing",
                    components=[],
                    missing_requirements=[f"scan_error: {e}"],
                )
            results[cap_name] = cap_status

        return results

    # ---------- 核心逻辑 ----------

    def _scan_single_capability(self, cap: CapabilitySpec) -> CapabilityStatus:
        """
        针对一个 capability：
        - 检查所有 components 是否存在
        - 粗略判断是否“占位”
        - 推导 overall_status
        """
        comp_statuses: List[ComponentStatus] = []

        for comp in cap.components:
            cs = self._check_component(comp)
            comp_statuses.append(cs)

        exists_flags = [c.exists for c in comp_statuses]
        placeholder_flags = [c.is_placeholder for c in comp_statuses if c.exists]

        if not exists_flags or not any(exists_flags):
            overall = "missing"
        else:
            # 至少有一个存在
            if placeholder_flags and all(placeholder_flags):
                overall = "placeholder"
            elif placeholder_flags and any(placeholder_flags):
                # 混合情况：有些占位，有些不是
                overall = "partial"
            else:
                overall = "implemented"

        # 简单策略：不是 implemented 的，就把所有 requirement id 当作 missing_requirements
        missing_requirements: List[str] = []
        if overall != "implemented":
            missing_requirements = [r.id for r in cap.requirements]

        return CapabilityStatus(
            name=cap.name,
            overall_status=overall,
            components=comp_statuses,
            missing_requirements=missing_requirements,
        )

    def _check_component(self, dotted_path: str) -> ComponentStatus:
        """
        检查某个组件路径是否存在，并尝试判断是否占位实现。

        dotted_path 示例：
        - "quentin.memory.fabric.MemoryFabric"
        - "quentin.traces.episode_builder.TraceEpisodeBuilder"
        """
        details: Dict[str, Any] = {}

        module_name, attr_name = self._split_module_attr(dotted_path)
        if not module_name:
            return ComponentStatus(
                component=dotted_path,
                exists=False,
                is_placeholder=False,
                details={"error": "invalid_path"},
            )

        try:
            module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
        except Exception as e:
            details["import_error"] = str(e)
            return ComponentStatus(
                component=dotted_path,
                exists=False,
                is_placeholder=False,
                details=details,
            )

        attr = getattr(module, attr_name, None)
        if attr is None:
            details["missing_attr"] = True
            return ComponentStatus(
                component=dotted_path,
                exists=False,
                is_placeholder=False,
                details=details,
            )

        details["attr_type"] = str(type(attr))

        if not self.placeholder_detection_enabled:
            # 只检查存在性，不做占位识别
            return ComponentStatus(
                component=dotted_path,
                exists=True,
                is_placeholder=False,
                details=details,
            )

        is_ph, ph_reason = self._is_placeholder(attr)
        if ph_reason:
            details["placeholder_reason"] = ph_reason

        return ComponentStatus(
            component=dotted_path,
            exists=True,
            is_placeholder=is_ph,
            details=details,
        )

    # ---------- 辅助函数 ----------

    @staticmethod
    def _split_module_attr(dotted_path: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], str]:
        """
        从 "package.module.ClassName" 里拆成：
        - module_name = "package.module"
        - attr_name = "ClassName"
        """
        if "." not in dotted_path:
            return None, dotted_path
        parts = dotted_path.split(".")
        module_name = ".".join(parts[:-1])
        attr_name = parts[-1]
        return module_name, attr_name

    def _is_placeholder(self, obj: Any) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:
        """
        粗略判断一个对象是不是“占位实现”。

        主要启发式：
        - 源码基本只有 pass
        - 或 raise NotImplementedError
        - 或只有注释/TODO，没有具体逻辑
        """
        try:
            source = inspect.getsource(obj)
        except (OSError, TypeError):  # builtin / C 扩展等
            return False, None

        src = source.strip()

        # 统一小写做简单匹配
        lower = src.lower()

        # 非常简单的启发式，你后续可以根据实际代码风格继续加规则
        if "notimplementederror" in lower:
            return True, "raises NotImplementedError"

        # 如果去掉空行和注释后几乎没有实质代码
        lines = [line.strip() for line in src.splitlines()]
        code_lines = [
            ln for ln in lines
            if ln
            and not ln.startswith("#")
            and not ln.startswith('"""')
            and not ln.startswith("'''")
        ]

        # 如果主体只有函数/类定义 + pass
        # 例如：
        # def foo(...):
        #     pass
        if len(code_lines) <= 3 and any("pass" == ln or ln.endswith("pass") for ln in code_lines):
            return True, "only pass / empty body"

        # 可以继续加规则，如 TODO/XXX 之类
        if "todo" in lower and "pass" in lower and len(code_lines) <= 6:
            return True, "mostly TODO with pass"

        return False, None

    # ---------- 输出工具 ----------

    @staticmethod
    def format_results_as_dict(
        results: Dict[str, CapabilityStatus]
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        把 CapabilityStatus 映射成可以直接 JSON dump 的字典。
        """
        out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        for name, cs in results.items():
            out[name] = {
                "overall_status": cs.overall_status,
                "missing_requirements": cs.missing_requirements,
                "components": [
                    {
                        "component": c.component,
                        "exists": c.exists,
                        "is_placeholder": c.is_placeholder,
                        "details": c.details,
                    }
                    for c in cs.components
                ],
            }
        return out

    @staticmethod
    def format_results_as_json(
        results: Dict[str, CapabilityStatus],
        indent: int = 2,
    ) -> str:
        return json.dumps(
            BlueprintGapTracker.format_results_as_dict(results),
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=indent,
        )

# quentin/cli/qctl.py
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging
from pathlib import Path

from quentin.blueprint.tracker import BlueprintGapTracker

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def cmd_blueprint_scan(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    bp_path = args.blueprint or "quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml"
    tracker = BlueprintGapTracker.from_file(bp_path)
    results = tracker.scan()
    print(BlueprintGapTracker.format_results_as_json(results))


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="qctl", description="Project Quentin CLI")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    # blueprint-scan
    p_scan = subparsers.add_parser(
        "blueprint-scan", help="Scan current repo against meta_agent_v3 blueprint"
    )
    p_scan.add_argument(
        "--blueprint",
        type=str,
        default="quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml",
        help="Path to blueprint YAML file",
    )
    p_scan.set_defaults(func=cmd_blueprint_scan)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

一、定义自我改进任务结构：ImprovementTask
文件：quentin/self_improvement/schemas.py

# quentin/self_improvement/schemas.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional


TASK_STATUS_PENDING = "pending"
TASK_STATUS_IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
TASK_STATUS_DONE = "done"
TASK_STATUS_ABANDONED = "abandoned"

# 优先级越小越先做（1 > 2 > 3）
PRIORITY_HIGH = 1      # overall_status = missing
PRIORITY_MEDIUM = 2    # overall_status = placeholder / partial
PRIORITY_LOW = 3       # overall_status = implemented，但仍有优化空间（后面再用）


@dataclass
class ImprovementTask:
    """
    自我改进任务：
    由 BlueprintGapTracker 的结果生成，
    用来驱动 SelfProgrammingEngine / MultiLLMCouncil 等模块做演化。
    """
    task_id: str
    capability: str                # e.g. "memory_fabric"
    requirement_id: Optional[str]  # e.g. "mf.search_semantic"（有些可能是 None）
    overall_status: str            # 能力当前状态：missing / placeholder / partial / implemented
    status: str = TASK_STATUS_PENDING
    priority: int = PRIORITY_MEDIUM
    title: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "ImprovementTask":
        return cls(**data)

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        """
        一个稳定的逻辑主键:
        capability + requirement_id (如果有的话)
        """
        if self.requirement_id:
            return f"{self.capability}:{self.requirement_id}"
        return self.capability
说明：

任务以“某个能力 + 某个 requirement”为粒度（例如 memory_fabric + mf.search_semantic）。

task_id 可以等于 key（也可以再加前缀，这里我们后面在 manager 里统一生成）。

以后 SelfProgrammingEngine / ResearchLayer 都可以直接用这个结构。

二、任务管理器 + 文件存储：SelfImprovementManager
这里先用最简单、通用的实现：

用一个 JSON 文件当任务存储（后面你想换成 KVStore / DB 直接把 Store 抽象替换掉就行）。

文件：quentin/self_improvement/manager.py

# quentin/self_improvement/manager.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional

from quentin.blueprint.tracker import BlueprintGapTracker, CapabilityStatus
from quentin.self_improvement.schemas import (
    ImprovementTask,
    TASK_STATUS_PENDING,
    PRIORITY_HIGH,
    PRIORITY_MEDIUM,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class FileBackedTaskStore:
    """
    最简单的任务存储：一个 JSON 文件，里面是 {task_id: task_dict}
    以后如果要换成 DB/KV，只需要实现同样的接口。
    """

    def __init__(self, path: str | Path = "data/improvement_tasks.json") -> None:
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self._loaded = False

    def _load(self) -> None:
        if self._loaded:
            return
        if self.path.exists():
            try:
                with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    self._cache = json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception("Failed to load task store from %s", self.path)
                self._cache = {}
        else:
            self._cache = {}
        self._loaded = True

    def _save(self) -> None:
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self.path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self._cache, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def get_all(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        self._load()
        return dict(self._cache)

    def get(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        self._load()
        return self._cache.get(task_id)

    def upsert(self, task: ImprovementTask) -> None:
        self._load()
        self._cache[task.task_id] = task.to_dict()
        self._save()

    def bulk_upsert(self, tasks: List[ImprovementTask]) -> None:
        self._load()
        for t in tasks:
            self._cache[t.task_id] = t.to_dict()
        self._save()


class SelfImprovementManager:
    """
    自我改进总调度（v1）：
    - 从 BlueprintGapTracker 的结果生成/更新 ImprovementTask
    - 提供任务列表给其他模块使用
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        blueprint_path: str = "quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml",
        store: Optional[FileBackedTaskStore] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.blueprint_path = blueprint_path
        self.store = store or FileBackedTaskStore()
        self.tracker = BlueprintGapTracker.from_file(blueprint_path)

    # --------- 对外主入口：同步蓝皮书任务 ----------

    def sync_blueprint_tasks(self) -> List[ImprovementTask]:
        """
        1. 使用 BlueprintGapTracker.scan() 获取当前 repo 对照蓝皮书的状态
        2. 把非 implemented 的 capability 转换成任务
        3. 旧任务如果仍然未完成，保持状态；如果蓝皮书已经补齐，后面可以考虑自动标记为 done（现在先不动）
        """
        gap_results = self.tracker.scan()
        existing = self._load_existing_tasks_indexed()

        new_or_updated: List[ImprovementTask] = []

        for cap_name, cap_status in gap_results.items():
            if cap_status.overall_status == "implemented":
                # 未来可以考虑：如果某 cap 之前有任务，现在已经 implemented，可以自动标记为 done
                continue

            # 如果 missing_requirements 为空，就以 capability 为粒度建一个通用任务
            req_ids = cap_status.missing_requirements or [None]

            for req_id in req_ids:
                task_id = self._make_task_id(cap_name, req_id)
                existing_task = existing.get(task_id)

                if existing_task:
                    # 已存在的任务：只更新整体状态/优先级，不改变已手动改过的 status（比如 in_progress）
                    updated = self._update_existing_task_from_cap(
                        existing_task, cap_status, req_id
                    )
                    new_or_updated.append(updated)
                else:
                    # 新任务
                    new_task = self._create_task_from_cap(
                        cap_status, req_id
                    )
                    new_or_updated.append(new_task)

        if new_or_updated:
            self.store.bulk_upsert(new_or_updated)

        return new_or_updated

    # --------- 任务查询接口 ----------

    def list_tasks(self, status: Optional[str] = None) -> List[ImprovementTask]:
        raw = self.store.get_all()
        tasks: List[ImprovementTask] = [
            ImprovementTask.from_dict(d) for d in raw.values()
        ]
        if status:
            tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.status == status]
        # 按 priority 排一下（小的在前）
        tasks.sort(key=lambda t: t.priority)
        return tasks

    # --------- 内部辅助 ----------

    def _load_existing_tasks_indexed(self) -> Dict[str, ImprovementTask]:
        raw = self.store.get_all()
        tasks = {tid: ImprovementTask.from_dict(d) for tid, d in raw.items()}
        return tasks

    @staticmethod
    def _make_task_id(capability: str, requirement_id: Optional[str]) -> str:
        if requirement_id:
            return f"{capability}:{requirement_id}"
        return capability

    @staticmethod
    def _priority_for_cap_status(status: str) -> int:
        """
        简单优先级策略：
        - missing    -> HIGH
        - placeholder/partial -> MEDIUM
        - implemented -> LOW（暂时用不到）
        """
        if status == "missing":
            return PRIORITY_HIGH
        if status in ("placeholder", "partial"):
            return PRIORITY_MEDIUM
        return 99  # implemented 或其他情况，目前不作为自改任务优先处理

    def _create_task_from_cap(
        self,
        cap_status: CapabilityStatus,
        requirement_id: Optional[str],
    ) -> ImprovementTask:
        priority = self._priority_for_cap_status(cap_status.overall_status)
        cap_name = cap_status.name
        task_id = self._make_task_id(cap_name, requirement_id)

        title = f"[{cap_status.overall_status}] capability={cap_name}"
        if requirement_id:
            title += f" / req={requirement_id}"

        description = f"Auto-generated from blueprint gap: capability={cap_name}, status={cap_status.overall_status}"
        if requirement_id:
            description += f", missing requirement={requirement_id}"

        meta: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "overall_status": cap_status.overall_status,
            "components": [
                {
                    "component": c.component,
                    "exists": c.exists,
                    "is_placeholder": c.is_placeholder,
                }
                for c in cap_status.components
            ],
        }

        return ImprovementTask(
            task_id=task_id,
            capability=cap_name,
            requirement_id=requirement_id,
            overall_status=cap_status.overall_status,
            status=TASK_STATUS_PENDING,
            priority=priority,
            title=title,
            description=description,
            meta=meta,
        )

    def _update_existing_task_from_cap(
        self,
        existing_task: ImprovementTask,
        cap_status: CapabilityStatus,
        requirement_id: Optional[str],
    ) -> ImprovementTask:
        # 更新 overall_status 和 priority，其余字段尽量保持不动
        existing_task.overall_status = cap_status.overall_status
        existing_task.priority = self._priority_for_cap_status(cap_status.overall_status)
        # meta 中更新最新的组件状态
        existing_task.meta["overall_status"] = cap_status.overall_status
        existing_task.meta["components"] = [
            {
                "component": c.component,
                "exists": c.exists,
                "is_placeholder": c.is_placeholder,
            }
            for c in cap_status.components
        ]
        return existing_task
说明：

核心函数：sync_blueprint_tasks()

把 BlueprintGapTracker.scan() 的结果 → 转成/更新 ImprovementTask。

overall_status != implemented 的 capability 都会生成任务。

任务 id 按 capability + requirement_id 组合，保证稳定/可重复同步。

任务存到 data/improvement_tasks.json，后面你要换成 DB，把 FileBackedTaskStore 换掉即可。

# quentin/cli/qctl.py
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging

from quentin.blueprint.tracker import BlueprintGapTracker
from quentin.self_improvement.manager import SelfImprovementManager

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def cmd_blueprint_scan(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    bp_path = args.blueprint or "quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml"
    tracker = BlueprintGapTracker.from_file(bp_path)
    results = tracker.scan()
    print(BlueprintGapTracker.format_results_as_json(results))


def cmd_improvement_sync(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    bp_path = args.blueprint or "quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml"
    manager = SelfImprovementManager(blueprint_path=bp_path)
    new_tasks = manager.sync_blueprint_tasks()
    logger.info("Synced %d tasks (new or updated).", len(new_tasks))
    # 可以简单打印一下新任务
    for t in new_tasks:
        logger.info(
            "Task: %s | cap=%s | req=%s | status=%s | priority=%s",
            t.task_id,
            t.capability,
            t.requirement_id,
            t.overall_status,
            t.priority,
        )


def cmd_improvement_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    status = args.status
    manager = SelfImprovementManager()
    tasks = manager.list_tasks(status=status)
    for t in tasks:
        print(
            f"- [{t.status}] (p={t.priority}) {t.task_id} :: {t.title}"
        )


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="qctl", description="Project Quentin CLI")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    # blueprint-scan
    p_scan = subparsers.add_parser(
        "blueprint-scan", help="Scan current repo against meta_agent_v3 blueprint"
    )
    p_scan.add_argument(
        "--blueprint",
        type=str,
        default="quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml",
        help="Path to blueprint YAML file",
    )
    p_scan.set_defaults(func=cmd_blueprint_scan)

    # improvement-sync
    p_sync = subparsers.add_parser(
        "improvement-sync",
        help="Sync self-improvement tasks from blueprint gaps",
    )
    p_sync.add_argument(
        "--blueprint",
        type=str,
        default="quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml",
        help="Path to blueprint YAML file",
    )
    p_sync.set_defaults(func=cmd_improvement_sync)

    # improvement-list
    p_list = subparsers.add_parser(
        "improvement-list",
        help="List self-improvement tasks",
    )
    p_list.add_argument(
        "--status",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Filter by task status (pending/in_progress/done/abandoned)",
    )
    p_list.set_defaults(func=cmd_improvement_list)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# quentin/self_improvement/design.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List

from quentin.self_improvement.schemas import ImprovementTask
from quentin.agents.multi_llm_council import (
    MultiLLMCouncil,
    CouncilResult,
)
from quentin.blueprint.spec import BlueprintSpec

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class DesignDraft:
    """
    针对某个 ImprovementTask，由多 AI 会议生成的“设计草案”。

    当前版本主要是保存：
    - 会议类型
    - 多个 proposal 的原文
    - 主持人合并后的综合方案
    - 风险复审意见
    后续可以再细化解析成更结构化的 plan/steps。
    """
    draft_id: str                # 例如 f"{task_id}:v1"
    task_id: str
    capability: str
    requirement_id: Optional[str]

    meeting_type: str            # planning / debugging / patch_review / reflection ...
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

    merged_answer: str = ""      # 主持人综合方案（CouncilResult.merged_answer）
    risks: str = ""              # 风险复审意见（CouncilResult.risks）

    council_meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    raw_proposals: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)

    blueprint_snapshot: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    task_snapshot: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "DesignDraft":
        return cls(**data)


class FileBackedDesignStore:
    """
    简单的设计草案存储：JSON 文件 {draft_id: draft_dict}
    """

    def __init__(self, path: str | Path = "data/improvement_designs.json") -> None:
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._loaded = False
        self._cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def _load(self) -> None:
        if self._loaded:
            return
        if self.path.exists():
            try:
                with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    self._cache = json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception("Failed to load design store from %s", self.path)
                self._cache = {}
        else:
            self._cache = {}
        self._loaded = True

    def _save(self) -> None:
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self.path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self._cache, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def upsert(self, draft: DesignDraft) -> None:
        self._load()
        self._cache[draft.draft_id] = draft.to_dict()
        self._save()

    def get_all(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        self._load()
        return dict(self._cache)

    def list_for_task(self, task_id: str) -> List[DesignDraft]:
        self._load()
        drafts = [
            DesignDraft.from_dict(d)
            for d in self._cache.values()
            if d.get("task_id") == task_id
        ]
        # 按创建时间排序
        drafts.sort(key=lambda d: d.created_at)
        return drafts
二、把多 AI 会议接到改进任务：ImprovementDesignPlanner
同一个文件里继续写（quentin/self_improvement/design.py）。

# 接上面的 import ...

from quentin.self_improvement.manager import SelfImprovementManager
from quentin.self_improvement.schemas import TASK_STATUS_PENDING
from quentin.agents.multi_llm_roles import MeetingType


class ImprovementDesignPlanner:
    """
    负责：
    - 从 ImprovementTask 中选一个任务
    - 拉取蓝皮书 spec 和 gap 信息
    - 调用 MultiLLMCouncil 开会
    - 生成 DesignDraft 存盘

    这一层相当于“研究/设计前置”，后面自编程引擎可以拿 DesignDraft 来写 patch。
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        blueprint_path: str = "quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml",
        council: Optional[MultiLLMCouncil] = None,
        task_store_path: str | Path = "data/improvement_tasks.json",
        design_store: Optional[FileBackedDesignStore] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.blueprint_path = blueprint_path
        self.blueprint = BlueprintSpec.load_from_file(blueprint_path)
        self.council = council or MultiLLMCouncil()
        self.si_manager = SelfImprovementManager(
            blueprint_path=blueprint_path,
        )
        self.design_store = design_store or FileBackedDesignStore()

    # ------------ 对外主入口：为单个任务生成设计草案 ------------

    def propose_design_for_task(
        self,
        task_id: str,
        meeting_type: MeetingType = "planning",
    ) -> DesignDraft:
        """
        针对指定的 ImprovementTask 召开一次“多 AI 设计会”，产出一个 DesignDraft。
        """
        task = self._get_task_by_id(task_id)
        if not task:
            raise ValueError(f"Task not found: {task_id}")

        # 构造会议问题 + 上下文
        problem, context = self._build_problem_and_context(task)

        # 调用多 AI 会议
        council_result: CouncilResult = self.council.deliberate(
            meeting_type=meeting_type,
            problem=problem,
            context=context,
        )

        # 把结果落为 DesignDraft
        draft_id = self._make_draft_id(task, suffix=f"{meeting_type}:{int(len(self.design_store.get_all())+1)}")

        draft = DesignDraft(
            draft_id=draft_id,
            task_id=task.task_id,
            capability=task.capability,
            requirement_id=task.requirement_id,
            meeting_type=meeting_type,
            merged_answer=council_result.merged_answer,
            risks=council_result.risks,
            council_meta=council_result.notes,
            raw_proposals=[
                {
                    "role_id": p.role_id,
                    "role_name": p.role_name,
                    "model": p.model,
                    "content": p.content,
                }
                for p in council_result.proposals
            ],
            blueprint_snapshot=self._snapshot_capability(task.capability),
            task_snapshot=task.to_dict(),
        )

        self.design_store.upsert(draft)
        logger.info("DesignDraft created: %s for task %s", draft.draft_id, task.task_id)

        return draft

    # ------------ 辅助：选任务 / 构造会议问题 / 截图蓝皮书 ------------

    def _get_task_by_id(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[ImprovementTask]:
        tasks = self.si_manager.list_tasks()
        for t in tasks:
            if t.task_id == task_id:
                return t
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _make_draft_id(task: ImprovementTask, suffix: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        base = f"{task.task_id}"
        if suffix:
            return f"{base}::{suffix}"
        return base

    def _snapshot_capability(self, capability_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        cap = self.blueprint.capabilities.get(capability_name)
        if not cap:
            return {}
        return {
            "name": cap.name,
            "layer": cap.layer,
            "category": cap.category,
            "description": cap.description,
            "components": cap.components,
            "requirements": [
                {
                    "id": r.id,
                    "type": r.type,
                    "description": r.description,
                }
                for r in cap.requirements
            ],
            "definition_of_done": cap.definition_of_done,
        }

    def _build_problem_and_context(self, task: ImprovementTask) -> tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        给 AI 会议的“问题 + 上下文”。
        目标：让它们知道：
        - 蓝皮书对这项能力的要求
        - 当前 repo 的 gap（来自 task.meta.components）
        - 我们希望输出什么样的设计结果
        """
        cap_spec = self.blueprint.capabilities.get(task.capability)

        problem = f"""我们需要为 Meta-Agent v3 蓝皮书中的能力 `{task.capability}` 设计一个落地实现方案。

具体目标：
- 当前状态：{task.overall_status}
- 对应蓝皮书 requirement: {task.requirement_id or "（无具体 requirement id，按能力整体设计）"}
- 输出：一份面向 Python 代码库的工程设计草案（包括模块结构、类/函数职责、关键数据结构、与现有组件的集成方式）。

请你们作为多位 AI 角色，从工程落地角度给出可执行的设计。
"""

        context: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "task": task.to_dict(),
            "capability_spec": self._snapshot_capability(task.capability),
            "gap_components": task.meta.get("components", []),
            "blueprint_id": self.blueprint.id,
            "blueprint_version": self.blueprint.version,
        }

        return problem, context
这里的策略非常简单直接：

问题里明确告诉 AI：“为 capability X + requirement Y 设计工程实现方案”

上下文放：蓝皮书需求片段 + 当前 gap 信息（组件是否存在/占位）。

多 AI 开会之后的结果全部保存在 DesignDraft。

三、CLI：qctl improvement-propose 调一次“多 AI 设计会”
还是在 quentin/cli/qctl.py 里加一个子命令：

def cmd_improvement_propose(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:

一、补丁数据结构：FilePatch / CodePatch / PatchReview
新文件：quentin/self_programming/patches.py

# quentin/self_programming/patches.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Literal, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

PatchType = Literal["unified_diff", "full_file"]

PATCH_STATUS_GENERATED = "generated"      # 已生成，但未评审/未测试
PATCH_STATUS_REVIEWED = "reviewed"        # 已有评审报告
PATCH_STATUS_APPROVED = "approved"        # 通过（可以进入后续应用环节）
PATCH_STATUS_REJECTED = "rejected"        # 拒绝（设计不合格/风险过高）
PATCH_STATUS_APPLIED = "applied"          # 已应用到代码库（后续可以加 git 钩子）


@dataclass
class FilePatch:
    """
    针对单个文件的补丁。

    两种模式：
    - unified_diff: 生成 GNU unified diff（适合后面直接打 patch）
    - full_file:    直接给出完整文件内容（适合新文件或重写较简单文件）
    """
    path: str
    patch_type: PatchType
    content: str


@dataclass
class PatchReview:
    """
    多 AI 评审后对补丁的总结。
    v1 先只存文本，后续可以结构化 decision / risk_level / required_changes。
    """
    review_id: str
    patch_id: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    reviewer: str = "multi_llm_council"
    summary: str = ""      # 综合评审意见（例如：可行/建议调整/高风险点）
    risks: str = ""        # 风险与不确定性列表（直接用 council 的 risks 文本）
    raw_council_output: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class CodePatch:
    """
    针对某个 ImprovementTask + DesignDraft 的完整补丁草案。
    """
    patch_id: str
    task_id: str
    draft_id: str
    capability: str
    requirement_id: Optional[str]

    status: str = PATCH_STATUS_GENERATED
    summary: str = ""           # 模型生成的简要说明（做了什么、为什么这么做）
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

    files: List[FilePatch] = field(default_factory=list)

    review: Optional[PatchReview] = None  # 多 AI 评审结果（可选）
    meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        # dataclass 嵌套已经展开了，不需要特殊处理
        return d

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "CodePatch":
        # 手动恢复嵌套类型
        files = [FilePatch(**f) for f in data.get("files", [])]
        review_data = data.get("review")
        review = PatchReview(**review_data) if review_data else None

        return cls(
            patch_id=data["patch_id"],
            task_id=data["task_id"],
            draft_id=data["draft_id"],
            capability=data["capability"],
            requirement_id=data.get("requirement_id"),
            status=data.get("status", PATCH_STATUS_GENERATED),
            summary=data.get("summary", ""),
            created_at=data.get("created_at", ""),
            updated_at=data.get("updated_at", ""),
            files=files,
            review=review,
            meta=data.get("meta", {}),
        )


class FileBackedPatchStore:
    """
    CodePatch 的最简单存储：一个 JSON 文件 {patch_id: patch_dict}
    """

    def __init__(self, path: str | Path = "data/improvement_patches.json") -> None:
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self._loaded = False

    def _load(self) -> None:
        if self._loaded:
            return
        if self.path.exists():
            try:
                with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    self._cache = json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception("Failed to load patch store from %s", self.path)
                self._cache = {}
        else:
            self._cache = {}
        self._loaded = True

    def _save(self) -> None:
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self.path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self._cache, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def get_all(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        self._load()
        return dict(self._cache)

    def get(self, patch_id: str) -> Optional[CodePatch]:
        self._load()
        d = self._cache.get(patch_id)
        if not d:
            return None
        return CodePatch.from_dict(d)

    def upsert(self, patch: CodePatch) -> None:
        self._load()
        self._cache[patch.patch_id] = patch.to_dict()
        self._save()
二、自编程引擎骨架：SelfProgrammingEngine
新文件：quentin/self_programming/engine.py

# quentin/self_programming/engine.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List

from quentin.models.ollama_client import OllamaClient
from quentin.self_programming.patches import (
    CodePatch,
    FilePatch,
    PatchReview,
    FileBackedPatchStore,
    PATCH_STATUS_GENERATED,
    PATCH_STATUS_REVIEWED,
)
from quentin.self_improvement.design import (
    ImprovementDesignPlanner,
    FileBackedDesignStore,
    DesignDraft,
)
from quentin.self_improvement.manager import SelfImprovementManager
from quentin.self_improvement.schemas import ImprovementTask
from quentin.agents.multi_llm_council import MultiLLMCouncil
from quentin.agents.multi_llm_roles import MeetingType

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SelfProgrammingEngine:
    """
    自编程引擎 v1（纯草案版本）：

    - 输入：DesignDraft（由多 AI 会议产生的设计草案）
    - 输出：CodePatch（代码补丁草案，包含待应用的文件 patch）
    - 评审：使用 MultiLLMCouncil 对 CodePatch 做一次 patch_review，生成 PatchReview

    v1 不负责真正执行测试和打 patch，只负责：
    - 生成补丁文本
    - 产出评审文本
    - 方便后续手动/自动集成 CI 流程
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        blueprint_path: str = "quentin/blueprint/meta_agent_v3.yaml",
        coder_model: str = "qwen3-vl:latest",
        ollama_client: Optional[OllamaClient] = None,
        patch_store: Optional[FileBackedPatchStore] = None,
        design_store: Optional[FileBackedDesignStore] = None,
        council: Optional[MultiLLMCouncil] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.blueprint_path = blueprint_path
        self.coder_model = coder_model
        self.client = ollama_client or OllamaClient()
        self.patch_store = patch_store or FileBackedPatchStore()
        self.design_store = design_store or FileBackedDesignStore()
        self.si_manager = SelfImprovementManager(blueprint_path=blueprint_path)
        self.council = council or MultiLLMCouncil()

    # -------- Patch 生成主入口 --------

    def propose_patch_for_design(
        self,
        draft_id: str,
    ) -> CodePatch:
        """
        根据指定的 DesignDraft 生成一个 CodePatch 草案。
        默认策略：
        - 使用 coder_model（如 qwen3-vl:latest）生成 JSON 格式的补丁描述
        - 如果 JSON 解析失败，则退化为 single full_file patch，把模型输出原样存入 content
        """
        draft = self._get_design_by_id(draft_id)
        if not draft:
            raise ValueError(f"DesignDraft not found: {draft_id}")

        task = self._get_task_by_id(draft.task_id)
        if not task:
            raise ValueError(f"Related ImprovementTask not found: {draft.task_id}")

        prompt = self._build_coder_prompt(draft, task)

        raw_answer = self.client.generate(
            model=self.coder_model,
            prompt=prompt,
            temperature=0.25,
            max_tokens=4096,
        )

        patch_data = self._parse_patch_answer(raw_answer)
        patch = self._build_code_patch_from_data(
            draft=draft,
            task=task,
            patch_data=patch_data,
            raw_answer=raw_answer,
        )

        self.patch_store.upsert(patch)
        logger.info("CodePatch created: %s for draft %s", patch.patch_id, draft.draft_id)
        return patch

    # -------- Patch 评审主入口（多 AI 会议 patch_review） --------

    def review_patch_with_council(
        self,
        patch_id: str,
        meeting_type: MeetingType = "patch_review",
    ) -> CodePatch:
        """
        使用 MultiLLMCouncil 对补丁做一次 patch_review：
        - 问题：这个补丁是否合理？风险在哪里？有无改进建议？
        - 输出：PatchReview，附加到 CodePatch 上，状态改为 reviewed
        """
        patch = self.patch_store.get(patch_id)
        if not patch:
            raise ValueError(f"CodePatch not found: {patch_id}")

        task = self._get_task_by_id(patch.task_id)
        if not task:
            raise ValueError(f"Related ImprovementTask not found: {patch.task_id}")

        draft = self._get_design_by_id(patch.draft_id)
        if not draft:
            raise ValueError(f"Related DesignDraft not found: {patch.draft_id}")

        problem, context = self._build_patch_review_problem_and_context(
            patch=patch,
            task=task,
            draft=draft,
        )

        council_result = self.council.deliberate(
            meeting_type=meeting_type,
            problem=problem,
            context=context,
        )

        review_id = f"{patch.patch_id}::review:{int(datetime.utcnow().timestamp())}"
        review = PatchReview(
            review_id=review_id,
            patch_id=patch.patch_id,
            summary=council_result.merged_answer,
            risks=council_result.risks,
            raw_council_output={
                "notes": council_result.notes,
                "proposals": [
                    {
                        "role_id": p.role_id,
                        "role_name": p.role_name,
                        "model": p.model,
                        "content": p.content,
                    }
                    for p in council_result.proposals
                ],
            },
        )

        patch.review = review
        patch.status = PATCH_STATUS_REVIEWED
        patch.updated_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()

        self.patch_store.upsert(patch)
        logger.info("CodePatch reviewed: %s", patch.patch_id)
        return patch

    # -------- 查询/辅助 --------

    def list_patches(self) -> List[CodePatch]:
        raw = self.patch_store.get_all()
        patches = [CodePatch.from_dict(d) for d in raw.values()]
        patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.created_at)
        return patches

    def _get_design_by_id(self, draft_id: str) -> Optional[DesignDraft]:
        all_drafts = self.design_store.get_all()
        d = all_drafts.get(draft_id)
        if not d:
            return None
        return DesignDraft.from_dict(d)

    def _get_task_by_id(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[ImprovementTask]:
        tasks = self.si_manager.list_tasks()
        for t in tasks:
            if t.task_id == task_id:
                return t
        return None

    # -------- Prompt 构造 --------

    def _build_coder_prompt(
        self,
        draft: DesignDraft,
        task: ImprovementTask,
    ) -> str:
        """
        给“写代码的模型”的提示词。
        目标：让它根据 DesignDraft 生成 JSON 结构的补丁。
        """
        cap_spec = draft.blueprint_snapshot
        design = draft.merged_answer
        risks = draft.risks

        return f"""你是一名资深 Python 工程师，正在为一个 Meta-Agent v3 系统编写代码补丁。

你的任务：
- 针对下面的“自我改进任务”和“设计草案”，生成一份代码补丁方案。
- 输出必须是严格的 JSON 格式，方便程序解析。

[自我改进任务]
{json.dumps(task.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

[对应蓝皮书能力说明]
{json.dumps(cap_spec, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

[设计草案 - 综合方案]
{design}

[设计草案 - 风险与注意事项]
{risks}

[现有组件 Gap 信息]
{json.dumps(task.meta.get("components", []), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

输出要求（非常重要）：
1. 严格输出一个 JSON 对象，不要有任何解释性文字。
2. JSON 结构必须为：
{{
  "summary": "用中文简要说明补丁做了什么、修改哪些模块，以及为什么这样设计。",
  "files": [
    {{
      "path": "quentin/xxx/yyy.py",
      "patch_type": "unified_diff" 或 "full_file",
      "content": "补丁内容。对于 unified_diff 请使用标准 diff 语法；full_file 则提供完整文件文本。"
    }}
  ]
}}

3. 如果你不确定某些文件的精确现有内容，可以：
   - 使用 full_file 给出你认为合理的完整文件实现；
   - 或在 unified_diff 中以注释形式标明“假设原始内容为...”。

现在请只输出 JSON，不要使用 markdown，不要加解释。
"""

    def _build_patch_review_problem_and_context(
        self,
        patch: CodePatch,
        task: ImprovementTask,
        draft: DesignDraft,
    ) -> tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        给多 AI 会议的 patch_review 问题+上下文。
        """
        problem = f"""请对下面这份 CodePatch 做全面的代码评审，重点关注：
1. 设计是否和 DesignDraft 一致？
2. 是否有明显的错误风险（如状态不一致、异常未处理、边界条件遗漏）？
3. 对 Meta-Agent v3 的安全内核/数据协议是否有潜在破坏？
4. 建议的改进方向。

注意：你们不需要输出具体代码，只需要给出评审结论。
"""

        context: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "task": task.to_dict(),
            "design_draft": draft.to_dict(),
            "code_patch": patch.to_dict(),
        }
        return problem, context

    # -------- 解析 LLM 输出为 patch_data --------

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_patch_answer(raw_answer: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        尝试从 LLM 输出中解析 JSON。
        如果失败，则退化为一个单文件 full_file patch，把原始输出存进去。
        """
        text = raw_answer.strip()
        # 有些模型可能会前后加解释性文字，这里简单 heuristic 提取 { ... } 段落
        start = text.find("{")
        end = text.rfind("}")
        if start != -1 and end != -1 and end > start:
            candidate = text[start : end + 1]
        else:
            candidate = text

        try:
            data = json.loads(candidate)
            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                raise ValueError("Top-level JSON is not an object")
            return data
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Failed to parse patch JSON, fallback to raw full_file patch: %s", e)
            return {
                "summary": "LLM 输出未能解析为结构化 JSON，已使用 raw 输出作为单文件补丁。",
                "files": [
                    {
                        "path": "NOT_APPLIED/raw_patch.txt",
                        "patch_type": "full_file",
                        "content": raw_answer,
                    }
                ],
            }

    @staticmethod
    def _build_code_patch_from_data(
        draft: DesignDraft,
        task: ImprovementTask,
        patch_data: Dict[str, Any],
        raw_answer: str,
    ) -> CodePatch:
        """
        把 JSON 转成 CodePatch 对象。
        """
        summary = patch_data.get("summary", "")
        files_data = patch_data.get("files", [])

        files: List[FilePatch] = []
        for f in files_data:
            try:
                fp = FilePatch(
                    path=str(f.get("path", "")),
                    patch_type=f.get("patch_type", "full_file"),  # type: ignore
                    content=str(f.get("content", "")),
                )
                files.append(fp)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning("Failed to parse file patch entry %s: %s", f, e)

        if not files:
            # 安全兜底：至少有一个 raw 文件
            files = [
                FilePatch(
                    path="NOT_APPLIED/raw_patch.txt",
                    patch_type="full_file",
                    content=raw_answer,
                )
            ]

        patch_id = f"{task.task_id}::draft={draft.draft_id}::ts={int(datetime.utcnow().timestamp())}"

        meta: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "raw_llm_output": raw_answer[:2000],  # 截断存一下，防止太大
        }

        return CodePatch(
            patch_id=patch_id,
            task_id=task.task_id,
            draft_id=draft.draft_id,
            capability=task.capability,
            requirement_id=task.requirement_id,
            status=PATCH_STATUS_GENERATED,
            summary=summary,
            files=files,
            meta=meta,
        )

一、在 patches.py 里增加测试相关结构
文件：quentin/self_programming/patches.py

1. 新增：PatchTestCaseResult / PatchTestReport
# quentin/self_programming/patches.py （节选）

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Literal, Optional

# ... 你原来的 import 不变

# -------------- 已有的 FilePatch 这里略 --------------

@dataclass
class PatchTestCaseResult:
    """
    单条测试用例结果（这里既可以表示单元测试，也可以表示一次整体命令的结果）。
    """
    name: str                       # 用例名或命令名，如 "pytest::all" / "unit.test_xxx"
    status: str                     # "passed" | "failed" | "error" | "skipped" | "not_run"
    duration_sec: Optional[float] = None
    error_message: Optional[str] = None
    extra: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class PatchTestReport:
    """
    针对某个 CodePatch 的测试报告。

    v1 只记录基本统计：
    - 成功/失败/错误/跳过数量
    - 总耗时
    - 静态分析结果（如 flake8/mypy/ruff 等，可后续扩展）
    """
    report_id: str
    patch_id: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

    success: bool = False
    total_cases: int = 0
    passed: int = 0
    failed: int = 0
    errored: int = 0
    skipped: int = 0
    runtime_sec: Optional[float] = None

    static_analysis: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    cases: List[PatchTestCaseResult] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "report_id": self.report_id,
            "patch_id": self.patch_id,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "success": self.success,
            "total_cases": self.total_cases,
            "passed": self.passed,
            "failed": self.failed,
            "errored": self.errored,
            "skipped": self.skipped,
            "runtime_sec": self.runtime_sec,
            "static_analysis": self.static_analysis,
            "cases": [asdict(c) for c in self.cases],
        }

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "PatchTestReport":
        cases = [
            PatchTestCaseResult(**c)
            for c in data.get("cases", [])
        ]
        return cls(
            report_id=data["report_id"],
            patch_id=data["patch_id"],
            created_at=data.get("created_at", ""),
            success=data.get("success", False),
            total_cases=data.get("total_cases", 0),
            passed=data.get("passed", 0),
            failed=data.get("failed", 0),
            errored=data.get("errored", 0),
            skipped=data.get("skipped", 0),
            runtime_sec=data.get("runtime_sec"),
            static_analysis=data.get("static_analysis", {}),
            cases=cases,
        )

改成（新增 tests）：

@dataclass
class CodePatch:
    patch_id: str
    task_id: str
    draft_id: str
    capability: str
    requirement_id: Optional[str]

    status: str = PATCH_STATUS_GENERATED
    summary: str = ""
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

    files: List[FilePatch] = field(default_factory=list)

    # 新增：测试报告
    tests: Optional[PatchTestReport] = None

    # 已有：多 AI 评审结果
    review: Optional[PatchReview] = None

    meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        # asdict 会递归展开 dataclass（包括 tests / review / files）
        return d

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "CodePatch":
        files = [FilePatch(**f) for f in data.get("files", [])]

        review_data = data.get("review")
        review = PatchReview(**review_data) if review_data else None

        tests_data = data.get("tests")
        tests = PatchTestReport.from_dict(tests_data) if tests_data else None

        return cls(
            patch_id=data["patch_id"],
            task_id=data["task_id"],
            draft_id=data["draft_id"],
            capability=data["capability"],
            requirement_id=data.get("requirement_id"),
            status=data.get("status", PATCH_STATUS_GENERATED),
            summary=data.get("summary", ""),
            created_at=data.get("created_at", ""),
            updated_at=data.get("updated_at", ""),
            files=files,
            tests=tests,
            review=review,
            meta=data.get("meta", {}),
        )
