@dataclass
class Patch:
    """
    自编程引擎所管理的“补丁”最小数据结构。
    """

    patch_id: str

    # 作用目标：repo 内部的路径（相对路径）
    target_path: str
    target_symbol: Optional[str] = None

    change_type: str = "refactor"

    intent: str = ""
    patch_text: str = ""
    tests: str = ""

    created_by: str = "selfprog"
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

    # 评估与状态
    status: str = "proposed"             # proposed/evaluated/approved/rejected/applied/rolled_back
    risk_level: str = "unknown"

    eval_report: Optional[PatchEvalReport] = None

    # NEW: 审批 & 应用信息
    gate_decision: Optional[str] = None  # "approve"/"reject"/"needs_human"
    gate_reason: Optional[str] = None
    applied_at: Optional[str] = None
    applied_environment: Optional[str] = None  # "staging"/"production"/...

    # NEW: 备份信息（用于回滚）
    backup_path: Optional[str] = None    # 存原始文件的备份路径

    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        if self.eval_report is not None:
            d["eval_report"] = self.eval_report.to_dict()
        return d

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d: Dict[str, Any]) -> "Patch":
        eval_data = d.get("eval_report")
        if eval_data:
            eval_report = PatchEvalReport(
                ok=eval_data.get("ok", False),
                score=float(eval_data.get("score", 0.0)),
                risk_level=eval_data.get("risk_level", "unknown"),
                issues=list(eval_data.get("issues", []) or []),
                warnings=list(eval_data.get("warnings", []) or []),
            )
        else:
            eval_report = None

        return cls(
            patch_id=d["patch_id"],
            target_path=d.get("target_path", ""),
            target_symbol=d.get("target_symbol"),
            change_type=d.get("change_type", "refactor"),
            intent=d.get("intent", ""),
            patch_text=d.get("patch_text", ""),
            tests=d.get("tests", ""),
            created_by=d.get("created_by", "selfprog"),
            created_at=d.get("created_at"),
            updated_at=d.get("updated_at"),
            status=d.get("status", "proposed"),
            risk_level=d.get("risk_level", "unknown"),
            eval_report=eval_report,
            gate_decision=d.get("gate_decision"),
            gate_reason=d.get("gate_reason"),
            applied_at=d.get("applied_at"),
            applied_environment=d.get("applied_environment"),
            backup_path=d.get("backup_path"),
            metadata=d.get("metadata", {}) or {},
        )
二、PatchGateCouncil：多 AI 开会审批补丁
新文件：quentin/selfprog/gate.py

# quentin/selfprog/gate.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
import json
import logging

from quentin.llm.multi_council import MultiAICouncil, CouncilDecision
from quentin.llm.types import LLMConfig
from quentin.selfprog.models import Patch, PatchEvalReport

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class PatchGateDecision:
    decision: str          # "approve" | "reject" | "needs_human"
    reason: str
    max_environment: str   # "staging" | "production"

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class PatchGateCouncil:
    """
    多 AI 开会审批补丁：

    - 输入：Patch + （可选）PatchEvalReport
    - 输出：PatchGateDecision（approve/reject/needs_human + reason + 最大允许环境）

    这里不直接改 Patch，只给出决策，由外层 PatchApplier 来更新 Patch 状态。
    """

    def __init__(self, council: Optional[MultiAICouncil] = None) -> None:
        if council is None:
            members = [
                LLMConfig(
                    provider="ollama",
                    model="qwen3-vl:latest",
                    role="governor",
                ),
                LLMConfig(
                    provider="ollama",
                    model="deepseek-r1:1.5b",
                    role="risk_analyst",
                ),
            ]
            council = MultiAICouncil(members=members)
        self.council = council

    def review_patch(
        self,
        patch: Patch,
        environment: str = "staging",
    ) -> PatchGateDecision:
        eval_report: Optional[PatchEvalReport] = patch.eval_report

        ctx_lines = [
            f"PATCH_ID        : {patch.patch_id}",
            f"TARGET_PATH     : {patch.target_path}",
            f"TARGET_SYMBOL   : {patch.target_symbol or '<unknown>'}",
            f"CHANGE_TYPE     : {patch.change_type}",
            f"CURRENT_STATUS  : {patch.status}",
            f"RISK_LEVEL      : {patch.risk_level}",
            f"REQUEST_ENV     : {environment}",
            "",
            "INTENT:",
            patch.intent,
            "",
            "PATCH_TEXT (truncated):",
            (patch.patch_text or "")[:3000],
        ]

        if eval_report is not None:
            ctx_lines.extend(
                [
                    "",
                    "EVAL_REPORT:",
                    f"- ok         : {eval_report.ok}",
                    f"- score      : {eval_report.score}",
                    f"- risk_level : {eval_report.risk_level}",
                    f"- issues     : {eval_report.issues}",
                    f"- warnings   : {eval_report.warnings}",
                ]
            )
        else:
            ctx_lines.append("\nEVAL_REPORT: <none>")

        context = "\n".join(ctx_lines)

        question = (
            "You are a PATCH GOVERNANCE COUNCIL of a self-evolving agent.\n"
            "You MUST decide whether this patch is allowed to be applied automatically.\n\n"
            "Possible decisions:\n"
            "- \"approve\": safe enough for automatic apply in the requested environment (staging/production).\n"
            "- \"reject\": too risky or clearly wrong; must NOT be applied.\n"
            "- \"needs_human\": ambiguous; human or external supervisor must review manually.\n\n"
            "You must be conservative:\n"
            "- If eval_report.ok is false or score < 0.7, you should usually reject or mark needs_human.\n"
            "- Prefer \"approve\" only when the risk seems low and the patch is well-tested.\n\n"
            "Return ONLY ONE JSON object with fields:\n"
            "{\n"
            "  \"decision\": \"approve\" | \"reject\" | \"needs_human\",\n"
            "  \"reason\": \"short explanation\",\n"
            "  \"max_environment\": \"staging\" | \"production\"\n"
            "}\n"
        )

        decision: CouncilDecision = self.council.deliberate(
            question=question,
            context=context,
            mode="patch_governance",
        )
        ans = decision.final_answer or "{}"

        try:
            s = ans.strip()
            first = s.find("{")
            last = s.rfind("}")
            if first != -1 and last != -1 and last > first:
                s = s[first : last + 1]
            data = json.loads(s)
            dec = str(data.get("decision", "needs_human"))
            reason = str(data.get("reason", "") or "no reason provided")
            max_env = str(data.get("max_environment", "staging"))
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("PatchGateCouncil: failed to parse council answer: %r", ans)
            dec = "needs_human"
            reason = "Failed to parse council JSON answer."
            max_env = "staging"

        if dec not in ("approve", "reject", "needs_human"):
            dec = "needs_human"

        if max_env not in ("staging", "production"):
            max_env = "staging"

        return PatchGateDecision(
            decision=dec,
            reason=reason,
            max_environment=max_env,
        )
三、PatchApplier：备份 + 应用 + 回滚
新文件：quentin/selfprog/apply.py

# quentin/selfprog/apply.py
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
from datetime import datetime
import shutil
import logging

from quentin.kernel.safety import SafetyKernel
from quentin.selfprog.models import Patch
from quentin.selfprog.registry import FileBackedPatchRegistry
from quentin.selfprog.gate import PatchGateCouncil, PatchGateDecision
from quentin.research.experiments import ResearchManager, Experiment

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PatchApplier:
    """
    负责：

    - gate_patch: 调多 AI 审批补丁，并更新 Patch.gate_decision / gate_reason / status
    - apply_patch: 在通过 gate + safety 后，备份文件，写入 patch_text，更新状态
    - rollback_patch: 用备份文件还原

    v1 简化策略：
      - 把 patch.patch_text 当作 “整个目标文件的新内容” 来写入
      - 不解析 diff（统一 diff 解析可以后面加）
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: str | Path = ".",
        registry: Optional[FileBackedPatchRegistry] = None,
        safety_kernel: Optional[SafetyKernel] = None,
        gate_council: Optional[PatchGateCouncil] = None,
        research_manager: Optional[ResearchManager] = None,
        backup_dir: str | Path = "data/patch_backups",
    ) -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.registry = registry or FileBackedPatchRegistry()
        self.safety_kernel = safety_kernel or SafetyKernel(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.gate_council = gate_council or PatchGateCouncil()
        self.research_manager = research_manager or ResearchManager()
        self.backup_dir = self.repo_root / backup_dir
        self.backup_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ---------- 补丁审批（多 AI 开会） ----------

    def gate_patch(
        self,
        patch_id: str,
        environment: str = "staging",
    ) -> Optional[Patch]:
        patch = self.registry.get_patch(patch_id)
        if not patch:
            logger.warning("PatchApplier.gate_patch: patch not found: %s", patch_id)
            return None

        decision: PatchGateDecision = self.gate_council.review_patch(patch, environment=environment)

        patch.gate_decision = decision.decision
        patch.gate_reason = decision.reason
        patch.updated_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()

        # 更新 patch.status
        if decision.decision == "approve":
            patch.status = "approved"
        elif decision.decision == "reject":
            patch.status = "rejected"
        else:
            # "needs_human"
            patch.status = "evaluated" if patch.status == "evaluated" else patch.status

        self.registry.upsert_patch(patch)
        self._record_gate_experiment(patch, decision)

        return patch

    # ---------- 应用补丁 ----------

    def apply_patch(
        self,
        patch_id: str,
        environment: str = "staging",
        *,
        require_gate: bool = True,
        min_score: float = 0.7,
    ) -> Optional[Patch]:
        """
        应用补丁（写文件）：

        安全逻辑（v1）：
          1. 如果 require_gate=True，且 gate_decision 不是 approve -> 拒绝
          2. SafetyKernel.check_self_programming_target(target_path) 决定是否允许
          3. 如果 eval_report 存在但 ok=False 或 score<min_score -> 拒绝
          4. 备份原文件（若存在）
          5. 把 patch_text 写到目标文件（整体覆盖）
        """
        patch = self.registry.get_patch(patch_id)
        if not patch:
            logger.warning("PatchApplier.apply_patch: patch not found: %s", patch_id)
            return None

        # gate 检查
        if require_gate:
            if patch.gate_decision != "approve":
                logger.warning(
                    "PatchApplier.apply_patch: patch %s is not approved (gate_decision=%r).",
                    patch_id,
                    patch.gate_decision,
                )
                return patch

        # safety kernel 检查
        policy = self.safety_kernel.check_self_programming_target(patch.target_path)
        if policy.decision == "deny":
            logger.warning(
                "PatchApplier.apply_patch: safety kernel denies patch %s: %s",
                patch_id,
                policy.reason,
            )
            patch.status = "rejected"
            patch.gate_decision = patch.gate_decision or "reject"
            patch.gate_reason = (patch.gate_reason or "") + f" | safety_kernel: {policy.reason}"
            patch.updated_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
            self.registry.upsert_patch(patch)
            return patch

        # 评估结果检查
        if patch.eval_report is not None:
            if not patch.eval_report.ok or patch.eval_report.score < min_score:
                logger.warning(
                    "PatchApplier.apply_patch: patch %s eval_report not ok or score<%s.",
                    patch_id,
                    min_score,
                )
                return patch

        # 文件路径
        target_file = (self.repo_root / patch.target_path).resolve()
        target_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # 备份原文件（如果存在且还没备份）
        backup_path: Optional[Path] = None
        if target_file.exists():
            backup_path = self._backup_file(patch, target_file)
            patch.backup_path = str(backup_path) if backup_path else None

        # 写入 patch_text
        target_file.write_text(patch.patch_text or "", encoding="utf-8")

        # 更新 patch 状态
        now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        patch.applied_at = now
        patch.applied_environment = environment
        patch.status = "applied"
        patch.updated_at = now

        # 记录一些元信息
        patch.metadata.setdefault("apply_history", []).append(
            {
                "applied_at": now,
                "environment": environment,
                "backup_path": patch.backup_path,
            }
        )

        self.registry.upsert_patch(patch)
        self._record_apply_experiment(patch, environment, backup_path is not None)

        return patch

    # ---------- 回滚补丁 ----------

    def rollback_patch(self, patch_id: str) -> Optional[Patch]:
        """
        用备份文件回滚（如果有备份）。
        """
        patch = self.registry.get_patch(patch_id)
        if not patch:
            logger.warning("PatchApplier.rollback_patch: patch not found: %s", patch_id)
            return None

        if not patch.backup_path:
            logger.warning("PatchApplier.rollback_patch: patch %s has no backup_path.", patch_id)
            return patch

        backup_file = Path(patch.backup_path)
        target_file = (self.repo_root / patch.target_path).resolve()

        if not backup_file.exists():
            logger.warning(
                "PatchApplier.rollback_patch: backup file not found: %s",
                backup_file,
            )
            return patch

        # 还原
        target_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(backup_file, target_file)

        now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        patch.status = "rolled_back"
        patch.updated_at = now
        patch.metadata.setdefault("rollback_history", []).append(
            {
                "rolled_back_at": now,
                "backup_path": patch.backup_path,
            }
        )
        self.registry.upsert_patch(patch)

        self._record_rollback_experiment(patch)
        return patch

    # ---------- 内部：备份 ----------

    def _backup_file(self, patch: Patch, target_file: Path) -> Optional[Path]:
        try:
            backup_name = f"{patch.patch_id}.orig"
            backup_path = self.backup_dir / backup_name
            shutil.copy2(target_file, backup_path)
            return backup_path
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("PatchApplier._backup_file: failed to backup %s", target_file)
            return None

    # ---------- 内部：Research 记录 ----------

    def _get_or_create_experiment(
        self,
        capability: str,
        requirement_id: str,
        purpose: str,
        tags: list[str],
    ) -> Experiment:
        rm = self.research_manager
        exps = rm.list_experiments()
        for e in exps:
            if (
                e.capability == capability
                and e.requirement_id == requirement_id
                and e.purpose == purpose
            ):
                return e
        return rm.create_experiment(
            name=purpose,
            purpose=purpose,
            capability=capability,
            requirement_id=requirement_id,
            tags=tags,
        )

    def _record_gate_experiment(self, patch: Patch, decision: PatchGateDecision) -> None:
        exp = self._get_or_create_experiment(
            capability="selfprog:patch_gate",
            requirement_id="patch_governance_quality",
            purpose="patch_gate_council",
            tags=["selfprog", "gate"],
        )
        ok = 1 if decision.decision == "approve" else 0
        self.research_manager.record_run(
            experiment_id=exp.experiment_id,
            variant_id="baseline_v1",
            metrics={"approved": ok},
            context={
                "patch_id": patch.patch_id,
                "decision": decision.decision,
                "max_environment": decision.max_environment,
            },
        )

    def _record_apply_experiment(
        self,
        patch: Patch,
        environment: str,
        had_backup: bool,
    ) -> None:
        exp = self._get_or_create_experiment(
            capability="selfprog:patch_apply",
            requirement_id="patch_apply_success_rate",
            purpose="patch_apply",
            tags=["selfprog", "apply"],
        )
        self.research_manager.record_run(
            experiment_id=exp.experiment_id,
            variant_id=environment,
            metrics={"applied": 1, "had_backup": int(had_backup)},
            context={
                "patch_id": patch.patch_id,
                "target_path": patch.target_path,
                "environment": environment,
            },
        )

    def _record_rollback_experiment(self, patch: Patch) -> None:
        exp = self._get_or_create_experiment(
            capability="selfprog:patch_rollback",
            requirement_id="patch_rollback_rate",
            purpose="patch_rollback",
            tags=["selfprog", "rollback"],
        )
        self.research_manager.record_run(
            experiment_id=exp.experiment_id,
            variant_id="baseline_v1",
            metrics={"rolled_back": 1},
            context={
                "patch_id": patch.patch_id,
                "target_path": patch.target_path,
            },
        )

def cmd_patch_gate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    applier = PatchApplier()
    patch = applier.gate_patch(args.patch_id, environment=args.env)
    if not patch:
        print(f"Patch not found: {args.patch_id}")
        return

    print(f"Patch {patch.patch_id} gate result:")
    print(f"- status        : {patch.status}")
    print(f"- gate_decision : {patch.gate_decision}")
    print(f"- gate_reason   : {patch.gate_reason}")
    print(f"- risk_level    : {patch.risk_level}")
    if patch.eval_report:
        print(f"- eval_score    : {patch.eval_report.score}")
        print(f"- eval_ok       : {patch.eval_report.ok}")


def cmd_patch_apply(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    applier = PatchApplier()
    patch = applier.apply_patch(
        args.patch_id,
        environment=args.env,
        require_gate=not args.no_gate,
    )
    if not patch:
        print(f"Patch not found: {args.patch_id}")
        return

    print(f"Patch {patch.patch_id} apply attempt finished.")
    print(f"- status            : {patch.status}")
    print(f"- applied_at        : {patch.applied_at}")
    print(f"- applied_env       : {patch.applied_environment}")
    print(f"- backup_path       : {patch.backup_path}")
    print(f"- gate_decision     : {patch.gate_decision}")
    print(f"- gate_reason       : {patch.gate_reason}")


def cmd_patch_rollback(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    applier = PatchApplier()
    patch = applier.rollback_patch(args.patch_id)
    if not patch:
        print(f"Patch not found: {args.patch_id}")
        return

    print(f"Patch {patch.patch_id} rollback attempt finished.")
    print(f"- status        : {patch.status}")
    print(f"- backup_path   : {patch.backup_path}")

# quentin/core/traces.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


@dataclass
class ExecutionTrace:
    """
    一次任务执行的最小结构化 Trace（供 ImmuneLoop / SleepLoop 使用）。

    注意：这不是完整日志，只是“免疫 / 研究”关心的那部分摘要。
    """

    trace_id: str
    task_id: str

    # 哪个模块/能力在工作（比如 "planner", "executor", "skill:open_file"）
    component_id: str

    # 蓝皮书中的能力 ID（可选），让 ImmuneLoop 能直接对上 blueprint capability
    blueprint_capability_id: Optional[str] = None

    # 代码位置（可选）——如果知道是哪个模块出了问题，可以填 module / symbol
    target_module: Optional[str] = None      # 如 "quentin.core.cognitive_loop"
    target_symbol: Optional[str] = None      # 如 "CognitiveLoop.run_task"

    success: bool = True
    error_type: Optional[str] = None         # e.g. "TimeoutError", "ValidationError"
    error_message: Optional[str] = None

    start_time: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    end_time: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

    # 一些通用指标（可以按需扩展）
    metrics: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ImmuneCase:
    """
    ImmuneLoop 发现的一个“异常病例”。

    - severity          : 严重程度（low/medium/high）
    - action_type       : 建议动作类型（selfprog_patch / degrade / disable_feature / escalate / none）
    - related_traces    : 相关 trace_id 列表
    - proposed_module   : 建议优化的模块（可选）
    - proposed_symbol   : 建议优化的符号（可选）
    """

    case_id: str
    component_id: str
    severity: str
    action_type: str
    summary: str
    reason: str

    related_traces: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    blueprint_capability_id: Optional[str] = None
    proposed_module: Optional[str] = None
    proposed_symbol: Optional[str] = None

    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)
二、ImmuneLoop v1：异常检测 + 多 AI 诊断 + 触发自编程
新文件：quentin/core/immune_loop.py

# quentin/core/immune_loop.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import uuid
from collections import defaultdict, deque
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Deque, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from quentin.core.traces import ExecutionTrace, ImmuneCase
from quentin.llm.multi_council import MultiAICouncil, CouncilDecision
from quentin.llm.types import LLMConfig
from quentin.selfprog.engine import SelfProgrammingEngine
from quentin.selfprog.models import Patch
from quentin.research.experiments import ResearchManager, Experiment

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ImmuneLoop:
    """
    ImmuneLoop v1：

    - 接收 ExecutionTrace（任务执行结果）
    - 做简单异常检测（error rate、重复错误类型）
    - 出现异常时：
        1）用多 AI 会议模式生成 ImmuneCase（诊断 + 建议动作）
        2）如果建议是 selfprog_patch，自动调用 SelfProgrammingEngine.propose_patch(...)
    - 所有 ImmuneCase + 触发的 patch 记录进 ResearchManager，方便分析。

    注意：
    - 这里只做“发现+触发”，不做自动降级/熔断（那可以在后续版本扩展）。
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: str | Path = ".",
        research_manager: Optional[ResearchManager] = None,
        selfprog_engine: Optional[SelfProgrammingEngine] = None,
        council: Optional[MultiAICouncil] = None,
        trace_store_path: str | Path = "data/traces.jsonl",
        window_size: int = 50,
        error_rate_threshold: float = 0.5,
        min_window: int = 5,
    ) -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.research_manager = research_manager or ResearchManager()
        self.selfprog_engine = selfprog_engine or SelfProgrammingEngine(repo_root=self.repo_root)

        if council is None:
            members = [
                LLMConfig(
                    provider="ollama",
                    model="qwen3-vl:latest",
                    role="immune_diagnoser",
                ),
                LLMConfig(
                    provider="ollama",
                    model="deepseek-r1:1.5b",
                    role="root_cause_analyst",
                ),
            ]
            council = MultiAICouncil(members=members)
        self.council = council

        self.trace_store_path = self.repo_root / trace_store_path
        self.trace_store_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.window_size = window_size
        self.error_rate_threshold = error_rate_threshold
        self.min_window = min_window

        # 每个 component_id 一条滑动窗口
        self._recent_traces: Dict[str, Deque[ExecutionTrace]] = defaultdict(
            lambda: deque(maxlen=self.window_size)
        )

    # ---------- 对外 API：处理一条 Trace ----------

    def process_trace(self, trace: ExecutionTrace) -> Tuple[Optional[ImmuneCase], Optional[Patch]]:
        """
        主入口：

        1. 持久化 trace（写 jsonl）
        2. 更新滑动窗口
        3. 检测是否异常
        4. 如异常 -> 多 AI 诊断 ImmuneCase
        5. 如 action_type=selfprog_patch -> 自动提自编程补丁

        返回：(immune_case | None, patch | None)
        """
        self._store_trace(trace)
        self._recent_traces[trace.component_id].append(trace)

        is_abnormal, reason = self._detect_anomaly(trace.component_id)
        if not is_abnormal:
            return None, None

        immune_case = self._diagnose_case(trace.component_id, reason)
        patch: Optional[Patch] = None

        if immune_case and immune_case.action_type == "selfprog_patch":
            patch = self._trigger_self_programming(immune_case)

        self._record_research(immune_case, patch)
        return immune_case, patch

    # ---------- 内部：存储 Trace ----------

    def _store_trace(self, trace: ExecutionTrace) -> None:
        try:
            with self.trace_store_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(json.dumps(trace.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("ImmuneLoop: failed to store trace to %s", self.trace_store_path)

    # ---------- 内部：异常检测 ----------

    def _detect_anomaly(self, component_id: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """
        v1 简单策略：

        - 窗口内至少 min_window 条 trace
        - 若 failure rate > error_rate_threshold -> 异常
        - 或者最近 N 条都是同一个 error_type -> 异常
        """
        traces = list(self._recent_traces[component_id])
        n = len(traces)
        if n < self.min_window:
            return False, "window too small"

        failures = [t for t in traces if not t.success]
        failure_rate = len(failures) / n

        # 条件 1：失败率过高
        if failure_rate > self.error_rate_threshold:
            return True, f"High failure rate: {len(failures)}/{n} ({failure_rate:.2f})"

        # 条件 2：最近 3 条都是同一错误类型
        recent = traces[-3:] if n >= 3 else traces
        if recent and all(not t.success for t in recent):
            err_types = {t.error_type for t in recent}
            if len(err_types) == 1 and list(err_types)[0] is not None:
                return True, f"Repeated same error_type in recent traces: {list(err_types)[0]}"

        return False, "no anomaly detected"

    # ---------- 内部：多 AI 诊断 ImmuneCase ----------

    def _diagnose_case(self, component_id: str, anomaly_reason: str) -> ImmuneCase:
        traces = list(self._recent_traces[component_id])
        failures = [t for t in traces if not t.success]

        # 构造诊断上下文
        ctx_lines: List[str] = [
            f"COMPONENT_ID: {component_id}",
            f"ANOMALY_REASON: {anomaly_reason}",
            "",
            "RECENT_TRACES_SUMMARY:",
        ]

        for t in traces[-10:]:  # 最近 10 条
            ctx_lines.append(
                f"- trace_id={t.trace_id}, success={t.success}, "
                f"error_type={t.error_type}, metrics={t.metrics}"
            )

        ctx_lines.append("")
        ctx_lines.append("FAILURE_DETAILS (up to 5):")
        for t in failures[-5:]:
            ctx_lines.append(
                f"- trace_id={t.trace_id}, error_type={t.error_type}, "
                f"error_message={t.error_message}, target_module={t.target_module}, "
                f"target_symbol={t.target_symbol}, blueprint_capability_id={t.blueprint_capability_id}"
            )

        context = "\n".join(ctx_lines)

        question = (
            "You are the IMMUNE COUNCIL of a self-evolving AI agent.\n"
            "You must diagnose the anomaly and propose a SAFE action.\n\n"
            "Possible action_type:\n"
            "- \"selfprog_patch\": generate a self-programming patch for a specific module/symbol.\n"
            "- \"degrade\": suggest temporarily turning off or simplifying this component.\n"
            "- \"disable_feature\": suggest disabling a specific feature.\n"
            "- \"escalate\": require human or external supervisor review.\n"
            "- \"none\": no action needed.\n\n"
            "You MUST be conservative. Only choose \"selfprog_patch\" when:\n"
            "- there is a clear module/symbol to target, AND\n"
            "- the failure pattern is stable and reproducible.\n\n"
            "Return ONLY ONE JSON object:\n"
            "{\n"
            "  \"severity\": \"low\" | \"medium\" | \"high\",\n"
            "  \"action_type\": \"selfprog_patch\" | \"degrade\" | \"disable_feature\" | \"escalate\" | \"none\",\n"
            "  \"summary\": \"short summary of the problem\",\n"
            "  \"reason\": \"explain why you choose this action\",\n"
            "  \"blueprint_capability_id\": \"id-or-null\",\n"
            "  \"proposed_module\": \"quentin.xxx\" or null,\n"
            "  \"proposed_symbol\": \"ClassOrFuncName\" or null\n"
            "}\n"
        )

        decision: CouncilDecision = self.council.deliberate(
            question=question,
            context=context,
            mode="immune_diagnosis",
        )
        ans = decision.final_answer or "{}"

        try:
            s = ans.strip()
            first = s.find("{")
            last = s.rfind("}")
            if first != -1 and last != -1 and last > first:
                s = s[first : last + 1]
            data = json.loads(s)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("ImmuneLoop._diagnose_case: failed to parse council JSON: %r", ans)
            data = {
                "severity": "medium",
                "action_type": "escalate",
                "summary": "Failed to parse council answer.",
                "reason": "Fallback due to JSON parse error.",
                "blueprint_capability_id": None,
                "proposed_module": None,
                "proposed_symbol": None,
            }

        severity = str(data.get("severity", "medium"))
        action_type = str(data.get("action_type", "escalate"))
        summary = str(data.get("summary", ""))
        reason = str(data.get("reason", ""))
        bp_id = data.get("blueprint_capability_id")
        proposed_module = data.get("proposed_module")
        proposed_symbol = data.get("proposed_symbol")

        case_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        related_ids = [t.trace_id for t in failures[-10:]]

        immune_case = ImmuneCase(
            case_id=case_id,
            component_id=component_id,
            severity=severity,
            action_type=action_type,
            summary=summary,
            reason=reason,
            related_traces=related_ids,
            blueprint_capability_id=bp_id,
            proposed_module=proposed_module,
            proposed_symbol=proposed_symbol,
            metadata={
                "anomaly_reason": anomaly_reason,
            },
        )
        return immune_case

    # ---------- 内部：触发自编程 ----------

    def _trigger_self_programming(self, case: ImmuneCase) -> Optional[Patch]:
        """
        当 ImmuneCase.action_type == selfprog_patch 时被调用。
        """
        # 没有明确目标模块 -> 暂时只记录，不触发
        if not case.proposed_module:
            logger.warning(
                "ImmuneLoop._trigger_self_programming: no proposed_module for case %s; skip.",
                case.case_id,
            )
            return None

        target_module = case.proposed_module
        target_symbol = case.proposed_symbol

        # 简单把 module 转为文件路径
        from quentin.blueprint.auto_patcher import BlueprintGapAutoPatcher

        autopatcher = BlueprintGapAutoPatcher()  # 用它的 module_to_path 逻辑
        target_path = autopatcher._module_to_path(target_module)
        if not target_path:
            logger.warning(
                "ImmuneLoop._trigger_self_programming: cannot infer path from module %s; skip.",
                target_module,
            )
            return None

        # problem description 里包括 ImmuneCase 的 summary + reason
        problem_lines = [
            f"ImmuneCase ID: {case.case_id}",
            f"Component ID : {case.component_id}",
            f"Severity     : {case.severity}",
            f"Summary      : {case.summary}",
            f"Reason       : {case.reason}",
            "",
            "The immune loop has detected repeated failures and requests a self-programming patch",
            "to improve this module or symbol.",
        ]
        if case.blueprint_capability_id:
            problem_lines.append(f"Blueprint capability: {case.blueprint_capability_id}")

        problem = "\n".join(problem_lines)

        try:
            patch = self.selfprog_engine.propose_patch(
                target_path=target_path,
                problem_description=problem,
                change_type="refactor",
                target_symbol=target_symbol,
                extra_context=(
                    "This patch is triggered by ImmuneLoop due to repeated failures. "
                    "Focus on robustness, error handling, and safe fallback behaviors."
                ),
            )
            return patch
        except Exception:
            logger.exception(
                "ImmuneLoop._trigger_self_programming: propose_patch failed for case %s",
                case.case_id,
            )
            return None

    # ---------- 内部：记录 Research 实验 ----------

    def _record_research(
        self,
        case: Optional[ImmuneCase],
        patch: Optional[Patch],
    ) -> None:
        rm = self.research_manager

        capability = "immune:anomaly_handling"
        requirement_id = "immune_loop_effectiveness"

        exps = rm.list_experiments()
        exp: Optional[Experiment] = None
        for e in exps:
            if (
                e.capability == capability
                and e.requirement_id == requirement_id
                and e.purpose == "immune_loop"
            ):
                exp = e
                break

        if exp is None:
            exp = rm.create_experiment(
                name="ImmuneLoop",
                purpose="immune_loop",
                capability=capability,
                requirement_id=requirement_id,
                tags=["immune", "anomaly"],
            )

        metrics = {
            "has_case": int(case is not None),
            "has_patch": int(patch is not None),
        }
        ctx: Dict[str, any] = {}
        if case:
            ctx["case_id"] = case.case_id
            ctx["component_id"] = case.component_id
            ctx["severity"] = case.severity
            ctx["action_type"] = case.action_type
        if patch:
            ctx["patch_id"] = patch.patch_id
            ctx["patch_target_path"] = patch.target_path

        rm.record_run(
            experiment_id=exp.experiment_id,
            variant_id="baseline_v1",
            metrics=metrics,
            context=ctx,
        )
⚠️ 注意：这里有一个小“偷懒”的地方：_trigger_self_programming 里复用了 BlueprintGapAutoPatcher._module_to_path，这是为了避免重复写 module→path 的逻辑。如果你觉得不优雅，可以把这个方法提到一个公用 util 模块，比如 quentin/utils/modules.py。

在文件末尾加：

def cmd_immune_process_trace(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    import json as _json
    from pathlib import Path as _Path

    p = _Path(args.trace_file)
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"Trace file not found: {p}")
        return

    try:
        raw = _json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") or "{}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to parse trace JSON: {e}")
        return

    try:
        trace = ExecutionTrace(
            trace_id=raw.get("trace_id"),
            task_id=raw.get("task_id"),
            component_id=raw.get("component_id"),
            blueprint_capability_id=raw.get("blueprint_capability_id"),
            target_module=raw.get("target_module"),
            target_symbol=raw.get("target_symbol"),
            success=bool(raw.get("success", True)),
            error_type=raw.get("error_type"),
            error_message=raw.get("error_message"),
            start_time=raw.get("start_time") or "",
            end_time=raw.get("end_time") or "",
            metrics=raw.get("metrics") or {},
            tags=raw.get("tags") or {},
        )
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to construct ExecutionTrace: {e}")
        return

    immune = ImmuneLoop()
    immune_case, patch = immune.process_trace(trace)

    if not immune_case:
        print("No anomaly detected by ImmuneLoop. No ImmuneCase created.")
        return

    print("ImmuneCase created:")
    print(f"- case_id      : {immune_case.case_id}")
    print(f"- component_id : {immune_case.component_id}")
    print(f"- severity     : {immune_case.severity}")
    print(f"- action_type  : {immune_case.action_type}")
    print(f"- summary      : {immune_case.summary}")
    print(f"- reason       : {immune_case.reason}")

    if patch:
        print("\nPatch proposed by ImmuneLoop:")
        print(f"- patch_id     : {patch.patch_id}")
        print(f"- target_path  : {patch.target_path}")
        print(f"- target_sym   : {patch.target_symbol}")
        print(f"- status       : {patch.status}")
        print(f"- risk_level   : {patch.risk_level}")

一、MemoryFabric v1：最小可用的记忆织体
新文件：quentin/memory/fabric.py
（如果你之前已经有同名文件，可以把核心接口对齐）

# quentin/memory/fabric.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
import json
import logging
import uuid

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class MemoryItem:
    """
    v1 通用记忆条目结构：

    - tier   : STS/MTS/LTS（短/中/长期）
    - kind   : "semantic" | "procedural" | "episode" | ...
    - content: 具体内容（自然语言或简短结构）
    """

    memory_id: str
    tier: str              # "STS" | "MTS" | "LTS"
    kind: str              # "semantic" | "procedural" | "episode"
    content: str

    tags: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class FileBackedMemoryFabric:
    """
    v1 Memory Fabric：

    - 所有记忆写入 data/memory.jsonl
    - 暂时不做复杂检索，只提供最基础的 append + 简单 filter
    - SleepLoop 主要用它来写入：
        - semantic lessons（语义总结）
        - procedural hints（程序化提示/技能索引）
    """

    def __init__(self, *, repo_root: str | Path = ".", store_path: str | Path = "data/memory.jsonl") -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.store_path = self.repo_root / store_path
        self.store_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ---------- 写入 ----------

    def add_item(
        self,
        *,
        tier: str,
        kind: str,
        content: str,
        tags: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> MemoryItem:
        item = MemoryItem(
            memory_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            tier=tier,
            kind=kind,
            content=content,
            tags=tags or {},
        )
        self._append_raw(item)
        return item

    def add_semantic_lesson(
        self,
        *,
        tier: str,
        content: str,
        domain: Optional[str] = None,
        source: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> MemoryItem:
        tags = {}
        if domain:
            tags["domain"] = domain
        if source:
            tags["source"] = source
        tags["type"] = "lesson"
        return self.add_item(tier=tier, kind="semantic", content=content, tags=tags)

    def add_procedural_hint(
        self,
        *,
        tier: str,
        content: str,
        skill_id: Optional[str] = None,
        component_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> MemoryItem:
        tags: Dict[str, Any] = {"type": "procedural_hint"}
        if skill_id:
            tags["skill_id"] = skill_id
        if component_id:
            tags["component_id"] = component_id
        return self.add_item(tier=tier, kind="procedural", content=content, tags=tags)

    # ---------- 读取（简单版） ----------

    def load_all(self) -> List[MemoryItem]:
        items: List[MemoryItem] = []
        if not self.store_path.exists():
            return items
        try:
            with self.store_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    if not line.strip():
                        continue
                    d = json.loads(line)
                    items.append(
                        MemoryItem(
                            memory_id=d["memory_id"],
                            tier=d["tier"],
                            kind=d["kind"],
                            content=d["content"],
                            tags=d.get("tags", {}) or {},
                            created_at=d.get("created_at", ""),
                            updated_at=d.get("updated_at", ""),
                        )
                    )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("FileBackedMemoryFabric.load_all: failed to read %s", self.store_path)
        return items

    # ---------- 内部 ----------

    def _append_raw(self, item: MemoryItem) -> None:
        try:
            with self.store_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(json.dumps(item.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("FileBackedMemoryFabric._append_raw: failed to append to %s", self.store_path)
这就是一个最小可用的 MemoryFabric：SleepLoop 可以直接向这里写“经验总结”和“技能提示”。

# quentin/skills/models.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional


@dataclass
class SkillPerformanceStats:
    success_rate: float = 0.0
    usage_count: int = 0
    last_score: float = 0.0
    last_used_at: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass
class Skill:
    """
    v1 Skill 定义：

    - skill_id      : 全局唯一 ID
    - name          : 人类可读名字
    - domain        : 领域标签（"core" | "desktop" | "legal" | "trading" | "cross"）
    - module        : python module 路径
    - symbol        : 类名或函数名
    - description   : 这个技能做什么
    - origin        : "human" | "evolved"
    - safety_level  : "low" | "medium" | "high"
    - supersedes    : 被它取代的旧 skill_id（如有）
    """

    skill_id: str
    name: str
    domain: str
    module: str
    symbol: str
    description: str

    origin: str = "human"
    safety_level: str = "medium"
    supersedes: Optional[str] = None

    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat())

    performance_stats: SkillPerformanceStats = field(default_factory=SkillPerformanceStats)
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        d["performance_stats"] = asdict(self.performance_stats)
        return d

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d: Dict[str, Any]) -> "Skill":
        perf = d.get("performance_stats") or {}
        stats = SkillPerformanceStats(
            success_rate=float(perf.get("success_rate", 0.0)),
            usage_count=int(perf.get("usage_count", 0)),
            last_score=float(perf.get("last_score", 0.0)),
            last_used_at=perf.get("last_used_at"),
        )
        return cls(
            skill_id=d["skill_id"],
            name=d["name"],
            domain=d.get("domain", "core"),
            module=d["module"],
            symbol=d["symbol"],
            description=d.get("description", ""),
            origin=d.get("origin", "human"),
            safety_level=d.get("safety_level", "medium"),
            supersedes=d.get("supersedes"),
            created_at=d.get("created_at", ""),
            updated_at=d.get("updated_at", ""),
            performance_stats=stats,
            metadata=d.get("metadata", {}) or {},
        )

# quentin/skills/registry.py
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional
import json
import logging

from quentin.skills.models import Skill, SkillPerformanceStats

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class FileBackedSkillRegistry:
    """
    v1 SkillRegistry：

    - 所有技能存 data/skills.json
    - 提供 list/get/upsert/mark_supersedes 最基本操作
    """

    def __init__(self, *, repo_root: str | Path = ".", store_path: str | Path = "data/skills.json") -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.store_path = self.repo_root / store_path
        self.store_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._cache: Dict[str, Skill] = {}
        self._loaded = False

    # ---------- 公共 API ----------

    def list_skills(self) -> List[Skill]:
        self._ensure_loaded()
        return list(self._cache.values())

    def get_skill(self, skill_id: str) -> Optional[Skill]:
        self._ensure_loaded()
        return self._cache.get(skill_id)

    def upsert_skill(self, skill: Skill) -> None:
        self._ensure_loaded()
        self._cache[skill.skill_id] = skill
        self._flush()

    def mark_supersedes(self, new_skill_id: str, old_skill_id: str) -> None:
        self._ensure_loaded()
        new_skill = self._cache.get(new_skill_id)
        old_skill = self._cache.get(old_skill_id)
        if not new_skill or not old_skill:
            logger.warning(
                "FileBackedSkillRegistry.mark_supersedes: missing new_skill or old_skill (%s, %s)",
                new_skill_id,
                old_skill_id,
            )
            return
        new_skill.supersedes = old_skill.skill_id
        self._cache[new_skill_id] = new_skill
        self._flush()

    def update_performance(
        self,
        skill_id: str,
        *,
        success: bool,
        score: float,
    ) -> None:
        self._ensure_loaded()
        skill = self._cache.get(skill_id)
        if not skill:
            return
        s = skill.performance_stats
        s.usage_count += 1
        s.last_score = score
        s.last_used_at = skill.updated_at
        # 简单滚动 success_rate
        alpha = 0.2
        success_val = 1.0 if success else 0.0
        s.success_rate = (1 - alpha) * s.success_rate + alpha * success_val
        skill.performance_stats = s
        self._cache[skill_id] = skill
        self._flush()

    # ---------- 内部 ----------

    def _ensure_loaded(self) -> None:
        if self._loaded:
            return
        self._load()
        self._loaded = True

    def _load(self) -> None:
        if not self.store_path.exists():
            self._cache = {}
            return
        try:
            raw = json.loads(self.store_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") or "{}")
            self._cache = {sid: Skill.from_dict(sdata) for sid, sdata in raw.items()}
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("FileBackedSkillRegistry._load: failed to read %s", self.store_path)
            self._cache = {}

    def _flush(self) -> None:
        try:
            raw = {sid: s.to_dict() for sid, s in self._cache.items()}
            self.store_path.write_text(json.dumps(raw, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("FileBackedSkillRegistry._flush: failed to write %s", self.store_path)

# quentin/skills/evolution.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
import json
import logging
import uuid

from quentin.core.traces import ExecutionTrace
from quentin.llm.multi_council import MultiAICouncil, CouncilDecision
from quentin.llm.types import LLMConfig
from quentin.skills.models import Skill
from quentin.skills.registry import FileBackedSkillRegistry
from quentin.selfprog.engine import SelfProgrammingEngine
from quentin.selfprog.models import Patch
from quentin.memory.fabric import FileBackedMemoryFabric
from quentin.research.experiments import ResearchManager, Experiment

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class SkillEvolutionResult:
    skill: Optional[Skill]
    patch: Optional[Patch]
    reason: str

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class SkillEvolutionEngine:
    """
    v1 Skill Evolution：

    - 输入：某个 component_id 相关的高成功率 ExecutionTrace 列表
    - 通过 MultiAICouncil 总结出一个“候选技能描述 + 接口建议”
    - 调 SelfProgrammingEngine 生成 skill 代码文件（建议放 mutable/skills/ 下）
    - 在 SkillRegistry 中注册新 Skill
    - 可选：把这次技能抽象过程写入 MemoryFabric（semantic/procedural）

    注意：
    - v1 不做聚类，只是对传入的一批“已经筛好”的 trace 做抽象
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: str | Path = ".",
        skill_registry: Optional[FileBackedSkillRegistry] = None,
        memory_fabric: Optional[FileBackedMemoryFabric] = None,
        selfprog_engine: Optional[SelfProgrammingEngine] = None,
        research_manager: Optional[ResearchManager] = None,
        council: Optional[MultiAICouncil] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.skill_registry = skill_registry or FileBackedSkillRegistry(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.memory_fabric = memory_fabric or FileBackedMemoryFabric(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.selfprog_engine = selfprog_engine or SelfProgrammingEngine(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.research_manager = research_manager or ResearchManager()

        if council is None:
            members = [
                LLMConfig(
                    provider="ollama",
                    model="qwen3-vl:latest",
                    role="skill_designer",
                ),
                LLMConfig(
                    provider="ollama",
                    model="deepseek-r1:1.5b",
                    role="robustness_checker",
                ),
            ]
            council = MultiAICouncil(members=members)
        self.council = council

    # ---------- 主入口 ----------

    def propose_skill_from_traces(
        self,
        *,
        component_id: str,
        traces: List[ExecutionTrace],
        domain: str = "core",
    ) -> SkillEvolutionResult:
        """
        输入：某一 component 对应的一批“高成功率 trace”。

        返回：Skill + Patch（如果成功）或 None + None。
        """
        if not traces:
            return SkillEvolutionResult(skill=None, patch=None, reason="no traces provided")

        # 1) 多 AI 会议：生成技能抽象 spec
        spec = self._deliberate_skill_spec(component_id, traces)
        if not spec or not spec.get("module") or not spec.get("symbol"):
            return SkillEvolutionResult(skill=None, patch=None, reason="council did not produce valid spec")

        module = spec["module"]
        symbol = spec["symbol"]
        skill_name = spec.get("name") or f"{component_id}_skill"
        description = spec.get("description") or "Auto-evolved skill from high-success traces."

        # 建议把 auto skill 放到 mutable/skills 下
        target_path = self._module_to_path(module)
        if not target_path:
            return SkillEvolutionResult(
                skill=None,
                patch=None,
                reason=f"Cannot infer target_path from module {module}",
            )

        # 2) 构造给 SelfProgrammingEngine 的问题描述
        problem = self._build_problem_description(component_id, traces, spec, target_path)

        try:
            patch: Patch = self.selfprog_engine.propose_patch(
                target_path=target_path,
                problem_description=problem,
                change_type="new_module",
                target_symbol=symbol,
                extra_context=(
                    "This code should implement a reusable SKILL function/class. "
                    "Focus on clarity, robustness, and good docstrings. "
                    "Include at least one minimal test or usage example."
                ),
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("SkillEvolutionEngine.propose_skill_from_traces: propose_patch failed.")
            return SkillEvolutionResult(skill=None, patch=None, reason="selfprog propose_patch failed")

        # 3) 注册 Skill
        skill_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        skill = Skill(
            skill_id=skill_id,
            name=skill_name,
            domain=domain,
            module=module,
            symbol=symbol,
            description=description,
            origin="evolved",
            safety_level="low",  # 默认 low，后续可以调
        )
        self.skill_registry.upsert_skill(skill)

        # 4) 把这次技能抽象过程记进 MemoryFabric（semantic + procedural）
        self._store_memory(component_id, skill, traces, spec)

        # 5) 记录 Research 实验
        self._record_research(skill, patch, component_id)

        return SkillEvolutionResult(skill=skill, patch=patch, reason="ok")

    # ---------- 内部：多 AI 会议生成 skill spec ----------

    def _deliberate_skill_spec(
        self,
        component_id: str,
        traces: List[ExecutionTrace],
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        ctx_lines = [
            f"COMPONENT_ID: {component_id}",
            "",
            "SAMPLE SUCCESS TRACES (up to 5):",
        ]
        sample = traces[-5:] if len(traces) > 5 else traces
        for t in sample:
            ctx_lines.append(
                f"- trace_id={t.trace_id}, metrics={t.metrics}, tags={t.tags}"
            )

        context = "\n".join(ctx_lines)

        question = (
            "You are a SKILL DESIGN COUNCIL for a self-evolving agent.\n"
            "Given these successful executions for the same component_id, you must propose\n"
            "ONE reusable skill abstraction.\n\n"
            "The skill should be a single Python function or class method with a clear name,\n"
            "inputs and outputs, and a short description.\n\n"
            "Return ONLY one JSON object:\n"
            "{\n"
            "  \"name\": \"Human readable skill name\",\n"
            "  \"description\": \"What this skill does and when to use it\",\n"
            "  \"module\": \"mutable.skills.skill_xxx\",   // Python module path\n"
            "  \"symbol\": \"SkillClassOrFunctionName\"\n"
            "}\n"
        )

        decision: CouncilDecision = self.council.deliberate(
            question=question,
            context=context,
            mode="skill_design",
        )
        ans = decision.final_answer or "{}"

        try:
            s = ans.strip()
            first = s.find("{")
            last = s.rfind("}")
            if first != -1 and last != -1 and last > first:
                s = s[first : last + 1]
            data = json.loads(s)
            return {
                "name": str(data.get("name", "")),
                "description": str(data.get("description", "")),
                "module": str(data.get("module", "")),
                "symbol": str(data.get("symbol", "")),
            }
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("SkillEvolutionEngine._deliberate_skill_spec: parse error: %r", ans)
            return {}

    # ---------- 内部：problem description ----------

    def _build_problem_description(
        self,
        component_id: str,
        traces: List[ExecutionTrace],
        spec: Dict[str, Any],
        target_path: str,
    ) -> str:
        lines = [
            f"Component ID : {component_id}",
            "",
            "You are asked to implement a reusable SKILL inferred from high-success traces.",
            "Skill Spec (from council):",
            json.dumps(spec, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            "",
            "TARGET FILE:",
            target_path,
            "",
            "SAMPLE TRACES (success cases, up to 5):",
        ]
        sample = traces[-5:] if len(traces) > 5 else traces
        for t in sample:
            lines.append(
                f"- trace_id={t.trace_id}, metrics={t.metrics}, tags={t.tags}"
            )
        return "\n".join(lines)

    # ---------- 内部：module -> path ----------

    def _module_to_path(self, module_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
        if not module_name:
            return None
        parts = module_name.split(".")
        path = Path(*parts[:-1]) / f"{parts[-1]}.py"
        return str(path).replace("\\", "/")

    # ---------- 内部：存 Memory ----------

    def _store_memory(
        self,
        component_id: str,
        skill: Skill,
        traces: List[ExecutionTrace],
        spec: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        # semantic lesson
        lesson = (
            f"Skill '{skill.name}' was evolved from component '{component_id}'. "
            f"It is implemented at {skill.module}:{skill.symbol}. "
            "It captures a reusable pattern of successful executions."
        )
        self.memory_fabric.add_semantic_lesson(
            tier="MTS",
            content=lesson,
            domain="meta",
            source="skill_evolution",
        )

        # procedural hint
        hint = (
            f"When handling tasks for component '{component_id}', "
            f"consider using skill '{skill.name}' ({skill.module}:{skill.symbol}) "
            "for similar sub-problems."
        )
        self.memory_fabric.add_procedural_hint(
            tier="MTS",
            content=hint,
            skill_id=skill.skill_id,
            component_id=component_id,
        )

    # ---------- 内部：记录 Research ----------

    def _record_research(
        self,
        skill: Skill,
        patch: Patch,
        component_id: str,
    ) -> None:
        rm = self.research_manager
        capability = "skill:evolution"
        requirement_id = "skill_evolution_yield"

        exps = rm.list_experiments()
        exp: Optional[Experiment] = None
        for e in exps:
            if (
                e.capability == capability
                and e.requirement_id == requirement_id
                and e.purpose == "skill_evolution"
            ):
                exp = e
                break

        if exp is None:
            exp = rm.create_experiment(
                name="SkillEvolution",
                purpose="skill_evolution",
                capability=capability,
                requirement_id=requirement_id,
                tags=["skill", "evolution"],
            )

        rm.record_run(
            experiment_id=exp.experiment_id,
            variant_id="baseline_v1",
            metrics={"skill_generated": 1},
            context={
                "skill_id": skill.skill_id,
                "skill_module": skill.module,
                "skill_symbol": skill.symbol,
                "component_id": component_id,
                "patch_id": patch.patch_id,
                "patch_target_path": patch.target_path,
            },
        )
四、SleepLoop v1：夜间 consolidation + 触发 SkillEvolution
新文件：quentin/core/sleep_loop.py

# quentin/core/sleep_loop.py
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional
import json
import logging

from quentin.core.traces import ExecutionTrace
from quentin.memory.fabric import FileBackedMemoryFabric
from quentin.skills.evolution import SkillEvolutionEngine, SkillEvolutionResult
from quentin.research.experiments import ResearchManager, Experiment

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SleepLoop:
    """
    Sleep / Consolidation Loop v1：

    职责：
      1. 从 data/traces.jsonl 中加载最近一段时间的执行 Trace
      2. 按 component_id 统计成功/失败与成功率
      3. 对高成功率且样本数足够的 component：
           → 调用 SkillEvolutionEngine.propose_skill_from_traces
      4. 同时写一些 Nightly Semantic Lessons 到 MemoryFabric

    注意：
      - 不做在线调度，只是一个“批处理”，可以通过 qctl sleep-run 调用。
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: str | Path = ".",
        trace_store_path: str | Path = "data/traces.jsonl",
        memory_fabric: Optional[FileBackedMemoryFabric] = None,
        skill_evolution: Optional[SkillEvolutionEngine] = None,
        research_manager: Optional[ResearchManager] = None,
        lookback_hours: int = 24,
        min_traces_per_component: int = 10,
        min_success_rate: float = 0.8,
    ) -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.trace_store_path = self.repo_root / trace_store_path
        self.memory_fabric = memory_fabric or FileBackedMemoryFabric(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.skill_evolution = skill_evolution or SkillEvolutionEngine(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.research_manager = research_manager or ResearchManager()

        self.lookback_hours = lookback_hours
        self.min_traces_per_component = min_traces_per_component
        self.min_success_rate = min_success_rate

    # ---------- 主入口 ----------

    def run_once(self) -> Dict[str, SkillEvolutionResult]:
        """
        运行一次 SleepLoop：

        返回：每个 component_id 对应的 SkillEvolutionResult（如果有）
        """
        traces = self._load_recent_traces()
        by_component: Dict[str, List[ExecutionTrace]] = defaultdict(list)
        for t in traces:
            by_component[t.component_id].append(t)

        results: Dict[str, SkillEvolutionResult] = {}

        for component_id, comp_traces in by_component.items():
            stats = self._compute_stats(comp_traces)
            if (
                stats["count"] >= self.min_traces_per_component
                and stats["success_rate"] >= self.min_success_rate
            ):
                # 触发技能演化
                res = self.skill_evolution.propose_skill_from_traces(
                    component_id=component_id,
                    traces=comp_traces,
                    domain="core",
                )
                results[component_id] = res

                # 写一条 semantic lesson 总结这次 consolidation
                self._store_consolidation_lesson(component_id, stats, res)
            else:
                # 也可以写一些简单统计，但 v1 可以略过
                continue

        self._record_research(results)
        return results

    # ---------- 内部：加载最近 Trace ----------

    def _load_recent_traces(self) -> List[ExecutionTrace]:
        traces: List[ExecutionTrace] = []
        if not self.trace_store_path.exists():
            return traces

        cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(hours=self.lookback_hours)

        try:
            with self.trace_store_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    if not line.strip():
                        continue
                    d = json.loads(line)
                    start_time_str = d.get("start_time") or ""
                    try:
                        start_time = datetime.fromisoformat(start_time_str)
                    except Exception:
                        # 如果没写时间，就全部算进来
                        start_time = datetime.utcnow()
                    if start_time < cutoff:
                        continue

                    traces.append(
                        ExecutionTrace(
                            trace_id=d["trace_id"],
                            task_id=d.get("task_id", ""),
                            component_id=d["component_id"],
                            blueprint_capability_id=d.get("blueprint_capability_id"),
                            target_module=d.get("target_module"),
                            target_symbol=d.get("target_symbol"),
                            success=bool(d.get("success", True)),
                            error_type=d.get("error_type"),
                            error_message=d.get("error_message"),
                            start_time=start_time_str,
                            end_time=d.get("end_time") or "",
                            metrics=d.get("metrics") or {},
                            tags=d.get("tags") or {},
                        )
                    )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("SleepLoop._load_recent_traces: failed to read %s", self.trace_store_path)

        return traces

    # ---------- 内部：统计 ----------

    def _compute_stats(self, traces: List[ExecutionTrace]) -> Dict[str, float]:
        n = len(traces)
        succ = sum(1 for t in traces if t.success)
        fail = n - succ
        success_rate = succ / n if n > 0 else 0.0
        return {"count": n, "success": succ, "fail": fail, "success_rate": success_rate}

    # ---------- 内部：写 semantic lesson ----------

    def _store_consolidation_lesson(
        self,
        component_id: str,
        stats: Dict[str, float],
        evo_result: SkillEvolutionResult,
    ) -> None:
        if not evo_result.skill:
            return
        s = evo_result.skill
        lesson = (
            f"During sleep consolidation, component '{component_id}' had "
            f"{stats['count']} traces with success_rate={stats['success_rate']:.2f}. "
            f"A new skill '{s.name}' ({s.module}:{s.symbol}) was evolved to capture "
            "this behavior."
        )
        self.memory_fabric.add_semantic_lesson(
            tier="MTS",
            content=lesson,
            domain="meta",
            source="sleep_loop",
        )

    # ---------- 内部：Research 记录 ----------

    def _record_research(self, results: Dict[str, SkillEvolutionResult]) -> None:
        rm = self.research_manager
        capability = "sleep:consolidation"
        requirement_id = "sleep_loop_effectiveness"

        exps = rm.list_experiments()
        exp: Optional[Experiment] = None
        for e in exps:
            if (
                e.capability == capability
                and e.requirement_id == requirement_id
                and e.purpose == "sleep_loop"
            ):
                exp = e
                break

        if exp is None:
            exp = rm.create_experiment(
                name="SleepLoop",
                purpose="sleep_loop",
                capability=capability,
                requirement_id=requirement_id,
                tags=["sleep", "consolidation"],
            )

        n_components = len(results)
        n_skills = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r.skill is not None)

        rm.record_run(
            experiment_id=exp.experiment_id,
            variant_id="baseline_v1",
            metrics={
                "components_processed": n_components,
                "skills_evolved": n_skills,
            },
            context={},
        )

def cmd_sleep_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    loop = SleepLoop(
        lookback_hours=args.lookback_hours,
        min_traces_per_component=args.min_traces,
        min_success_rate=args.min_success_rate,
    )
    results = loop.run_once()

    if not results:
        print("SleepLoop finished. No components met evolution criteria.")
        return

    print("SleepLoop finished. Skill evolution summary:")
    for comp_id, res in results.items():
        if res.skill:
            print(
                f"- component={comp_id} => skill_id={res.skill.skill_id}, "
                f"name={res.skill.name}, module={res.skill.module}, symbol={res.skill.symbol}, "
                f"reason={res.reason}"
            )
        else:
            print(f"- component={comp_id} => no skill evolved (reason={res.reason})")
