# quentin/research/experiments.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json
import uuid
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# --------- 基本 Schema --------- #

@dataclass
class VariantConfig:
    """
    一个实验“变体”（Variant）的配置。

    - variant_id       : 唯一 ID（字符串）
    - name             : 人类可读名称
    - description      : 做什么改动，例如“planner 使用策略B”，“model_router 改成 bandit 策略”
    - target_component : 目标组件，例如 "planner" / "model_router" / "skill_evolution"
    - params           : 对该组件的参数改动（由对应 Runner 解释）
    - implementation_hint :
        可选，用于指明实现位置，比如 "quentin.planner.strategies:StrategyB"
        真正加载执行逻辑由 ExperimentRunner 处理。
    """
    variant_id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    target_component: str
    params: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    implementation_hint: Optional[str] = None

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ExperimentConfig:
    """
    实验配置：描述要对哪个组件做什么样的对比试验。

    - experiment_id    : 唯一 ID
    - name             : 标题，例如 "planner_strategies_v1"
    - purpose          : 实验目的（自然语言）
    - target_component : 实验作用的组件（与 VariantConfig.target_component 一致）
    - created_at       : ISO 时间
    - created_by       : 人/系统名（v1 可写 "system"）
    - status           : "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed"
    - metadata         : 任意附加信息（数据集信息 / 调度策略 / 域等）
    - variants         : 变体列表
    """
    experiment_id: str
    name: str
    purpose: str
    target_component: str
    created_at: str
    created_by: str
    status: str = "pending"
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    variants: List[VariantConfig] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        # dataclasses 默认会把 dataclass 展开；这里 variants 已是 dict 列表了
        return d


@dataclass
class VariantResult:
    """
    单个 Variant 的评测结果。
    metrics 里可以放任意指标，如:
      - "success_rate"
      - "avg_latency"
      - "avg_cost"
      - "reward"
    """
    variant_id: str
    metrics: Dict[str, float]
    extra: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ExperimentResult:
    """
    整个 Experiment 的结果汇总。
    """
    experiment_id: str
    status: str  # "pending" | "running" | "completed" | "failed"
    started_at: Optional[str] = None
    finished_at: Optional[str] = None
    variant_results: List[VariantResult] = field(default_factory=list)
    best_variant_id: Optional[str] = None
    best_metric_name: Optional[str] = None
    notes: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


# --------- 存储层：ExperimentStore --------- #

class ExperimentStore:
    """
    v1: 用文件系统存 ExperimentConfig 和 ExperimentResult。
    将来可替换为 DB / 对象存储。
    """

    def __init__(self, *, repo_root: str | Path = ".") -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.base_dir = self.repo_root / "data" / "experiments"
        self.base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.config_dir = self.base_dir / "configs"
        self.config_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.result_dir = self.base_dir / "results"
        self.result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ---- Config 操作 ---- #
    def create_experiment(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        purpose: str,
        target_component: str,
        created_by: str = "system",
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        variants: Optional[List[VariantConfig]] = None,
    ) -> ExperimentConfig:
        experiment_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
        cfg = ExperimentConfig(
            experiment_id=experiment_id,
            name=name,
            purpose=purpose,
            target_component=target_component,
            created_at=datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
            created_by=created_by,
            status="pending",
            metadata=metadata or {},
            variants=variants or [],
        )
        self.save_config(cfg)
        return cfg

    def save_config(self, cfg: ExperimentConfig) -> None:
        path = self.config_dir / f"{cfg.experiment_id}.json"
        try:
            path.write_text(
                json.dumps(cfg.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("ExperimentStore: failed to save config %s", path)

    def load_config(self, experiment_id: str) -> Optional[ExperimentConfig]:
        path = self.config_dir / f"{experiment_id}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        try:
            obj = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            variants = [
                VariantConfig(
                    variant_id=v["variant_id"],
                    name=v.get("name", ""),
                    description=v.get("description", ""),
                    target_component=v.get("target_component", ""),
                    params=v.get("params", {}),
                    implementation_hint=v.get("implementation_hint"),
                )
                for v in obj.get("variants", [])
            ]
            return ExperimentConfig(
                experiment_id=obj["experiment_id"],
                name=obj["name"],
                purpose=obj.get("purpose", ""),
                target_component=obj.get("target_component", ""),
                created_at=obj.get("created_at", ""),
                created_by=obj.get("created_by", ""),
                status=obj.get("status", "pending"),
                metadata=obj.get("metadata", {}),
                variants=variants,
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("ExperimentStore: failed to load config %s", path)
            return None

    # ---- Result 操作 ---- #
    def save_result(self, result: ExperimentResult) -> None:
        path = self.result_dir / f"{result.experiment_id}.json"
        try:
            path.write_text(
                json.dumps(result.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("ExperimentStore: failed to save result %s", path)

    def load_result(self, experiment_id: str) -> Optional[ExperimentResult]:
        path = self.result_dir / f"{experiment_id}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        try:
            obj = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            variant_results = [
                VariantResult(
                    variant_id=v["variant_id"],
                    metrics=v.get("metrics", {}),
                    extra=v.get("extra", {}),
                )
                for v in obj.get("variant_results", [])
            ]
            return ExperimentResult(
                experiment_id=obj["experiment_id"],
                status=obj.get("status", "pending"),
                started_at=obj.get("started_at"),
                finished_at=obj.get("finished_at"),
                variant_results=variant_results,
                best_variant_id=obj.get("best_variant_id"),
                best_metric_name=obj.get("best_metric_name"),
                notes=obj.get("notes", ""),
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("ExperimentStore: failed to load result %s", path)
            return None
二、实验执行器：ExperimentOrchestrator + Runner 接口
2. 新文件：quentin/research/orchestrator.py
# quentin/research/orchestrator.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable
from datetime import datetime
import logging

from quentin.research.experiments import (
    ExperimentStore,
    ExperimentConfig,
    VariantConfig,
    ExperimentResult,
    VariantResult,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@runtime_checkable
class ExperimentRunner(Protocol):
    """
    某一类组件的实验执行器接口。

    比如：
    - PlannerRunner：对不同 planner 策略的 Variant 做评测
    - ModelRouterRunner：对不同路由策略做评测
    - SkillEvolutionRunner：对不同技能演化策略做评测

    run_variant 必须返回 VariantResult。
    """

    def run_variant(
        self,
        experiment: ExperimentConfig,
        variant: VariantConfig,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> VariantResult:
        ...


@dataclass
class OrchestratorConfig:
    """
    Orchestrator 的配置占位。
    目前没啥字段，以后可以放：
    - 默认评测 metric 名称
    - 同时运行的最大实验数量等
    """
    default_score_metric: str = "score"


class ExperimentOrchestrator:
    """
    v1：轻量实验编排器。

    特点：
    - 不绑定具体领域：只知道有“组件组件(component)”和“变体(variant)”；
    - 具体怎么评测由 ExperimentRunner 决定；
    - 结果统一写入 ExperimentStore。
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: str | None = None,
        store: Optional[ExperimentStore] = None,
        config: Optional[OrchestratorConfig] = None,
    ) -> None:
        from pathlib import Path

        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root or ".").resolve()
        self.store = store or ExperimentStore(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.config = config or OrchestratorConfig()

        # 每个 target_component 对应一个 Runner
        self.runners: Dict[str, ExperimentRunner] = {}

    # -------- Runner 注册 -------- #
    def register_runner(self, component: str, runner: ExperimentRunner) -> None:
        """
        注册某个组件的 Runner。

        component 如：
        - "planner"
        - "model_router"
        - "skill_evolution"
        """
        self.runners[component] = runner

    # -------- Experiment 管理 -------- #
    def create_experiment(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        purpose: str,
        target_component: str,
        created_by: str = "system",
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        variants: Optional[List[VariantConfig]] = None,
    ) -> ExperimentConfig:
        cfg = self.store.create_experiment(
            name=name,
            purpose=purpose,
            target_component=target_component,
            created_by=created_by,
            metadata=metadata,
            variants=variants,
        )
        logger.info(
            "ExperimentOrchestrator: created experiment %s for component=%s",
            cfg.experiment_id,
            target_component,
        )
        return cfg

    def run_experiment(
        self,
        experiment_id: str,
        *,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        score_metric: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> ExperimentResult:
        """
        顺序执行指定实验的所有 variants，并产生 ExperimentResult。

        - context 由具体 Runner 自行解释（可包含数据集路径、离线样本集等）
        """
        cfg = self.store.load_config(experiment_id)
        if cfg is None:
            raise ValueError(f"ExperimentOrchestrator: experiment {experiment_id} not found")

        runner = self.runners.get(cfg.target_component)
        if runner is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"ExperimentOrchestrator: no runner registered for component={cfg.target_component}"
            )

        result = ExperimentResult(
            experiment_id=experiment_id,
            status="running",
            started_at=datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
            finished_at=None,
            variant_results=[],
            best_variant_id=None,
            best_metric_name=None,
            notes="",
        )
        self.store.save_result(result)  # 立刻写一遍“running”状态

        metric_name = score_metric or self.config.default_score_metric
        best_score = None
        best_variant_id = None

        for v in cfg.variants:
            try:
                vr = runner.run_variant(cfg, v, context=context)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception(
                    "ExperimentOrchestrator: runner failed for experiment %s variant %s",
                    experiment_id,
                    v.variant_id,
                )
                # 失败也要写入一个结果占位
                vr = VariantResult(
                    variant_id=v.variant_id,
                    metrics={},
                    extra={"error": str(e)},
                )

            result.variant_results.append(vr)

            # 比较 score
            score = vr.metrics.get(metric_name)
            if score is not None:
                if best_score is None or score > best_score:
                    best_score = score
                    best_variant_id = v.variant_id

            # 每个 variant 跑完都可以增量保存一次（方便中断恢复）
            self.store.save_result(result)

        result.status = "completed"
        result.finished_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        result.best_variant_id = best_variant_id
        result.best_metric_name = metric_name

        if best_variant_id is None:
            result.notes = (
                "No variant produced a valid score metric; "
                "best_variant_id remains None. Check metrics or runner implementation."
            )

        self.store.save_result(result)
        logger.info(
            "ExperimentOrchestrator: experiment %s completed. best_variant=%s metric=%s score=%s",
            experiment_id,
            best_variant_id,
            metric_name,
            best_score,
        )
        return result

    def compare_variants(
        self,
        experiment_id: str,
        metric_name: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        简单比较实验中各变体在指定 metric 上的表现。
        返回结构：
        {
          "experiment_id": ...,
          "metric": ...,
          "best_variant_id": ...,
          "scores": { variant_id: score_or_None, ... }
        }
        """
        result = self.store.load_result(experiment_id)
        if result is None:
            return None

        m = metric_name or result.best_metric_name or self.config.default_score_metric
        scores: Dict[str, Optional[float]] = {}
        best_variant_id = None
        best_score = None

        for vr in result.variant_results:
            score = vr.metrics.get(m)
            scores[vr.variant_id] = score
            if score is not None:
                if best_score is None or score > best_score:
                    best_score = score
                    best_variant_id = vr.variant_id

        return {
            "experiment_id": experiment_id,
            "metric": m,
            "best_variant_id": best_variant_id,
            "scores": scores,
        }
现在这个 Orchestrator 完全是 领域无关 的：

对 Planner 的实验，只要注册一个 PlannerRunner 实现 run_variant；

对 Model Router 的实验，只要注册 ModelRouterRunner；

对 Skill Evolution 的实验，只要注册 SkillEvolutionRunner。

三、升级 ResearchInterface，真正接上 Orchestrator
之前 ResearchInterface 只是一个壳子；现在我们让它：

持有 ExperimentOrchestrator

在 create_experiment_from_case / run_experiment / compare_variants 里调用 orchestrator

修改文件：quentin/research/interface.py

1. 更新 import 和构造函数
# quentin/research/interface.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
import logging

from quentin.immune.store import ImmuneCase
from quentin.research.experiments import ExperimentStore, VariantConfig
from quentin.research.orchestrator import ExperimentOrchestrator

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ResearchInterface:
    """
    v1：一个轻量的 Research Layer 接口壳子 + ExperimentOrchestrator 适配层。

    主要职责：
    - 接收 ImmuneCase，做统一入口（当前打日志 + 可选自动生成实验）
    - 对上层暴露 create_experiment / run_experiment / compare_variants 等方法
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: str | None = None,
        orchestrator: Optional[ExperimentOrchestrator] = None,
        store: Optional[ExperimentStore] = None,
    ) -> None:
        from pathlib import Path

        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root or ".").resolve()
        self.store = store or ExperimentStore(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.orchestrator = orchestrator or ExperimentOrchestrator(
            repo_root=self.repo_root,
            store=self.store,
        )

    # ---- ImmuneCase 接口 ---- #
    def submit_immune_case(self, case: ImmuneCase) -> None:
        """
        ImmuneLoop 检测到异常后调用：
        - 当前：打日志；
        - 将来：可以自动生成实验，或推送到队列，由人/AI 决定是否开实验。
        """
        logger.info(
            "ResearchInterface: received immune case %s (type=%s severity=%s)",
            case.case_id,
            case.anomaly.get("anomaly_type"),
            case.anomaly.get("severity"),
        )
        # v1 不自动建实验，只是记录。
        # 若你想试验“全自动自演化”，可以在这里调用 create_experiment_from_case。

    # ---- 实验 API ---- #
    def create_experiment_from_case(self, case: ImmuneCase) -> str:
        """
        根据 ImmuneCase 创建一个简单的实验占位：
        比如：
        - 目标组件：planner / model_router / skill_evolution 等
        - 暂时创建两个占位 Variant（baseline / candidate），后续可以由 AI 来填充 params。
        """
        anomaly_type = case.anomaly.get("anomaly_type", "unknown")
        target_component = self._infer_target_component_from_case(case)

        name = f"auto_from_case_{case.case_id[:8]}"
        purpose = f"Auto experiment derived from immune case {case.case_id} ({anomaly_type})"

        # v1: 先生成两个占位 Variant，具体 params 由你后续填
        variants = [
            VariantConfig(
                variant_id="baseline",
                name="baseline",
                description="Current / previous stable configuration",
                target_component=target_component,
                params={"mode": "baseline"},
            ),
            VariantConfig(
                variant_id="candidate",
                name="candidate",
                description="New configuration to try (to be filled by AI/human).",
                target_component=target_component,
                params={"mode": "candidate"},
            ),
        ]

        cfg = self.orchestrator.create_experiment(
            name=name,
            purpose=purpose,
            target_component=target_component,
            created_by="immune_auto",
            metadata={
                "source_case_id": case.case_id,
                "anomaly_type": anomaly_type,
            },
            variants=variants,
        )
        logger.info(
            "ResearchInterface: created experiment %s from immune case %s",
            cfg.experiment_id,
            case.case_id,
        )
        return cfg.experiment_id

    def run_experiment(self, experiment_id: str, context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        运行某个实验，并返回结果的 dict。
        """
        result = self.orchestrator.run_experiment(experiment_id, context=context)
        return result.to_dict()

    def compare_variants(
        self,
        experiment_id: str,
        metric_name: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        比较实验中的各变体表现。
        """
        return self.orchestrator.compare_variants(experiment_id, metric_name=metric_name)

    # ---- 内部辅助 ---- #
    def _infer_target_component_from_case(self, case: ImmuneCase) -> str:
        """
        从 ImmuneCase 推断目标组件。
        v1: 极简版——只看 anomaly_type 和 goal_summary.domain。
        将来可以接更智能的推断（甚至让 AI 决定）。
        """
        domain = (case.goal_summary.get("domain") or "").lower()
        anomaly_type = case.anomaly.get("anomaly_type", "")

        # 示例规则：Trading 域优先给 model_router / risk_manager 做实验
        if "trading" in domain:
            return "model_router"
        # Legal 域优先给 planner / reasoning 做实验
        if "legal" in domain:
            return "planner"
        # 其他默认 planner
        if "high_failure_rate" in anomaly_type:
            return "planner"
        return "planner"
现在 ResearchInterface 真正具备了蓝皮书要求的几个核心 API：

create_experiment_from_case

run_experiment

compare_variants

ImmuneLoop 以后可以选择：

只提交 ImmuneCase；

或在严重异常时自动走一条“建实验 + 后台跑实验”的通路。

# quentin/eval/spec.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


@dataclass
class EvalTaskSpec:
    """
    单个评测任务（一个“样本”）。

    举例：
    - 对 planner：给定 goal / context，期望拆成多少步、大致结构
    - 对 model_router：给定任务特征，期望选择哪个模型、成本范围等
    """
    task_id: str
    description: str
    component: str              # "planner" / "model_router" / "skill_evolution" 等
    input_payload: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    expected_output: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class EvalDatasetSpec:
    """
    一组 EvalTask 的集合（一个评测数据集）。
    """
    dataset_id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    component: str                      # 针对哪个组件
    tasks: List[EvalTaskSpec] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        d["tasks"] = [t.to_dict() for t in self.tasks]
        return d


@dataclass
class EvalCaseResult:
    """
    单个任务的评测结果。
    """
    task_id: str
    variant_id: str
    success: bool
    score: float
    raw_output: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    notes: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)
二、EvalHarness：统一评测引擎 quentin/eval/harness.py
# quentin/eval/harness.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional
import logging

from quentin.eval.spec import EvalDatasetSpec, EvalTaskSpec, EvalCaseResult
from quentin.research.experiments import VariantConfig, VariantResult, ExperimentConfig

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

EvalFn = Callable[[EvalTaskSpec, VariantConfig, Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]


class EvalHarness:
    """
    通用评测引擎：

    - 给定 ExperimentConfig + VariantConfig + EvalDataset + eval_fn
    - 依次跑每个任务，收集 per-case 结果
    - 聚合得到 VariantResult（success_rate / avg_score / score）
    """

    def __init__(self, *, max_cases_in_extra: int = 100) -> None:
        self.max_cases_in_extra = max_cases_in_extra

    def run_dataset(
        self,
        experiment: ExperimentConfig,
        variant: VariantConfig,
        dataset: EvalDatasetSpec,
        eval_fn: EvalFn,
        *,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> VariantResult:
        """对某个 variant 在 dataset 上跑一次完整评测。"""
        ctx = dict(context or {})
        ctx.setdefault("experiment_id", experiment.experiment_id)
        ctx.setdefault("variant_id", variant.variant_id)
        ctx.setdefault("dataset_id", dataset.dataset_id)

        case_results: List[EvalCaseResult] = []
        success_count = 0
        score_sum = 0.0
        score_count = 0

        for task in dataset.tasks:
            try:
                raw = eval_fn(task, variant, ctx) or {}
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception(
                    "EvalHarness: eval_fn failed for experiment=%s variant=%s task=%s",
                    experiment.experiment_id,
                    variant.variant_id,
                    task.task_id,
                )
                raw = {"success": False, "score": 0.0, "error": str(e)}

            success = bool(raw.get("success", False))
            score = float(raw.get("score", 0.0))

            if success:
                success_count += 1
            score_sum += score
            score_count += 1

            case_results.append(
                EvalCaseResult(
                    task_id=task.task_id,
                    variant_id=variant.variant_id,
                    success=success,
                    score=score,
                    raw_output=raw,
                    notes=raw.get("notes", ""),
                )
            )

        n = len(dataset.tasks) or 1
        success_rate = success_count / n
        avg_score = (score_sum / score_count) if score_count > 0 else 0.0

        metrics = {
            "success_rate": float(success_rate),
            "avg_score": float(avg_score),
            # 为方便 Orchestrator 默认比较，提供一个总评分字段
            "score": float(avg_score),
        }

        # 为了不让结果 explode，只保留前 max_cases_in_extra 个样本的详情
        extra = {
            "dataset_id": dataset.dataset_id,
            "num_tasks": len(dataset.tasks),
            "case_results_preview": [
                cr.to_dict() for cr in case_results[: self.max_cases_in_extra]
            ],
        }

        return VariantResult(
            variant_id=variant.variant_id,
            metrics=metrics,
            extra=extra,
        )
现在任何组件的 ExperimentRunner，只要把“如何在单个 EvalTask 上运行这个 variant”表达成一个 eval_fn，就能直接复用 EvalHarness。

三、Planner 的示例 Runner：quentin/research/runners/planner_offline_runner.py
这是一个 离线 planner 评测 Runner 示例：

通过 context["planner_dataset"] 获取 EvalDatasetSpec

通过 planner_fn 把「任务 + 变体参数」转成 planner 输出

EvalHarness 负责聚合成 VariantResult

先放骨架 + stub planner，实现上留 TODO 给后续自演化/人工完善。

# quentin/research/runners/planner_offline_runner.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Callable
import logging

from quentin.research.orchestrator import ExperimentRunner
from quentin.research.experiments import (
    ExperimentConfig,
    VariantConfig,
    VariantResult,
)
from quentin.eval.spec import EvalDatasetSpec, EvalTaskSpec
from quentin.eval.harness import EvalHarness

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# planner_fn: (task, variant, context) -> dict with keys: success, score, notes, etc.
PlannerFn = Callable[[EvalTaskSpec, VariantConfig, Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]


class PlannerOfflineRunner(ExperimentRunner):
    """
    针对 planner 组件的离线评测 Runner。

    设计理念：
    - 不直接绑死到某个 Planner 实现；
    - 将“如何从 EvalTask 调用具体 planner”的逻辑放在 planner_fn 里；
    - 默认提供一个 stub_planner_fn，至少 pipeline 可以跑通。
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        eval_harness: Optional[EvalHarness] = None,
        planner_fn: Optional[PlannerFn] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.eval_harness = eval_harness or EvalHarness()
        self.planner_fn = planner_fn or self._stub_planner_fn

    def run_variant(
        self,
        experiment: ExperimentConfig,
        variant: VariantConfig,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> VariantResult:
        ctx = dict(context or {})

        dataset: Optional[EvalDatasetSpec] = ctx.get("planner_dataset") or ctx.get("eval_dataset")
        if dataset is None:
            logger.warning(
                "PlannerOfflineRunner: no EvalDatasetSpec provided in context "
                "(planner_dataset / eval_dataset missing). Using empty dataset."
            )
            dataset = EvalDatasetSpec(
                dataset_id="empty",
                name="empty",
                description="Empty dataset (no tasks).",
                component="planner",
                tasks=[],
            )

        if dataset.component != "planner":
            logger.warning(
                "PlannerOfflineRunner: dataset.component=%s but runner is for planner.",
                dataset.component,
            )

        def _eval_fn(task: EvalTaskSpec, variant_cfg: VariantConfig, local_ctx: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            return self.planner_fn(task, variant_cfg, local_ctx)

        return self.eval_harness.run_dataset(
            experiment=experiment,
            variant=variant,
            dataset=dataset,
            eval_fn=_eval_fn,
            context=ctx,
        )

    # ---------- 默认 stub planner ---------- #

    def _stub_planner_fn(
        self,
        task: EvalTaskSpec,
        variant: VariantConfig,
        context: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        一个简单的 stub 实现，目的是让 pipeline 能跑通。

        行为：
        - 如果 expected_output 里有非空 "reference_plan"，则认为 success=True, score=1.0；
        - 否则 success=False, score=0.0。

        实际项目中，你应该替换为：
        - 调用真正的 CognitiveLoop._run_planner 或 planner 策略；
        - 解析 planner 输出，将其与 expected_output 对比打分。
        """
        expected = task.expected_output or {}
        has_ref_plan = bool(expected.get("reference_plan"))

        success = has_ref_plan
        score = 1.0 if has_ref_plan else 0.0

        return {
            "success": success,
            "score": score,
            "notes": "stub_planner_fn used; replace with real planner integration.",
            "used_stub": True,
            "task_id": task.task_id,
            "variant_id": variant.variant_id,
        }
以后要接真实 planner，很简单：

写一个函数 real_planner_fn(task, variant, ctx)，里面调用 CognitiveLoop / PlannerCouncil；

初始化 PlannerOfflineRunner(planner_fn=real_planner_fn) 并注册到 Orchestrator。

一、ModelRouter 日志与统计：quentin/router/metrics.py
# quentin/router/metrics.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json
import uuid
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ModelRouteRequestRecord:
    """
    一次路由请求的结构化表示，用于记录和离线训练。

    注意：这里只是“记录”，真正的调用参数由 ModelRouter 决定。
    """
    task_type: str
    importance: str = "normal"     # "low" / "normal" / "high"
    domain: str = "general"
    constraints: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ModelRouteDecisionRecord:
    """
    ModelRouter 的决策结果（可持久化）。
    """
    model_id: str
    provider: str
    reason: str
    params: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ModelRouteOutcomeRecord:
    """
    路由决策的结果，用于学习路由策略。
    """
    success: Optional[bool] = None
    reward: Optional[float] = None
    cost_tokens: Optional[float] = None
    latency_ms: Optional[float] = None
    quality_score: Optional[float] = None  # 人工/AI 评价

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ModelRouteLogRecord:
    """
    完整的一次路由日志，用于 JSONL 持久化和训练数据。
    """
    log_id: str
    created_at: str
    request: Dict[str, Any]
    decision: Dict[str, Any]
    outcome: Dict[str, Any]
    runtime_flags: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    experiment_tags: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class ModelRouterLogStore:
    """
    v1：简单的 JSONL 日志，用于后续 Sleep Loop / Research 的离线训练。

    - append(log_record)
    - 可扩展：按需做简单统计聚合。
    """

    def __init__(self, *, repo_root: str | Path = ".") -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.base_dir = self.repo_root / "data" / "model_router"
        self.base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.jsonl_path = self.base_dir / "routes.jsonl"

    def append(
        self,
        *,
        request: ModelRouteRequestRecord,
        decision: ModelRouteDecisionRecord,
        outcome: Optional[ModelRouteOutcomeRecord] = None,
        runtime_flags: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        experiment_tags: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> ModelRouteLogRecord:
        log = ModelRouteLogRecord(
            log_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
            created_at=datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
            request=request.to_dict(),
            decision=decision.to_dict(),
            outcome=(outcome or ModelRouteOutcomeRecord()).to_dict(),
            runtime_flags=runtime_flags or {},
            experiment_tags=experiment_tags or {},
        )
        line = json.dumps(log.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False)
        try:
            with self.jsonl_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(line + "\n")
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("ModelRouterLogStore: failed to append route log to %s", self.jsonl_path)
        return log
现在每一次路由，都可以写成一个 JSONL 记录，后面 Sleep Loop / Research Layer 就有数据可以挖掘。

二、ModelRouter 核心骨架：quentin/core/model_router.py
这是一个通用、可实验的路由器实现，支持：

读取 runtime_flags（比如 degrade_mode）；

根据配置和 Variant 参数选择模型；

调用 ModelRouterLogStore 记日志。

# quentin/core/model_router.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from pathlib import Path
import logging

from quentin.router.metrics import (
    ModelRouteRequestRecord,
    ModelRouteDecisionRecord,
    ModelRouteOutcomeRecord,
    ModelRouterLogStore,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ModelRouteRequest:
    """
    CognitiveLoop / 其他组件请求路由时使用的结构。
    """
    task_type: str            # 如 "planning" / "execution" / "reflection" / "done_check"
    importance: str = "normal"
    domain: str = "general"   # "desktop" / "legal" / "trading" / "general" 等
    constraints: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_record(self) -> ModelRouteRequestRecord:
        return ModelRouteRequestRecord(
            task_type=self.task_type,
            importance=self.importance,
            domain=self.domain,
            constraints=self.constraints,
            metadata=self.metadata,
        )


@dataclass
class ModelRouteDecision:
    model_id: str
    provider: str
    reason: str
    params: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_record(self) -> ModelRouteDecisionRecord:
        return ModelRouteDecisionRecord(
            model_id=self.model_id,
            provider=self.provider,
            reason=self.reason,
            params=self.params,
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class ModelRouterConfig:
    """
    ModelRouter 的配置容器。

    v1：主要是静态映射 + 默认模型 ID。
    将来可以被 self-programming 引擎自动修改。
    """

    def __init__(self, raw: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> None:
        cfg = raw or {}
        self.default_model: str = cfg.get("default_model", "gpt_default")
        self.safe_model: str = cfg.get("safe_model", "gpt_safe")
        self.cheap_model: str = cfg.get("cheap_model", "gpt_cheap")

        # 按 task_type 映射
        self.by_task_type: Dict[str, str] = cfg.get("by_task_type", {})
        # 按 domain 映射
        self.by_domain: Dict[str, str] = cfg.get("by_domain", {})

        # 预留更多策略参数
        self.extra: Dict[str, Any] = cfg.get("extra", {})

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "default_model": self.default_model,
            "safe_model": self.safe_model,
            "cheap_model": self.cheap_model,
            "by_task_type": self.by_task_type,
            "by_domain": self.by_domain,
            "extra": self.extra,
        }


class ModelRouter:
    """
    通用 ModelRouter：

    - 支持 degrade_mode / runtime_flags
    - 支持通过 config 和 Variant params 调整策略
    - 每次决策都会写入 ModelRouterLogStore
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: str | Path = ".",
        base_config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        log_store: Optional[ModelRouterLogStore] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.config = ModelRouterConfig(base_config)
        self.log_store = log_store or ModelRouterLogStore(repo_root=self.repo_root)

    # --- 对外主接口 --- #
    def route(
        self,
        request: ModelRouteRequest,
        *,
        runtime_flags: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        variant_params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> ModelRouteDecision:
        """
        主路由函数：
        - request           : 当前任务的元信息
        - runtime_flags     : 来自 CognitiveLoop 的运行状态（如 degrade_mode / self_programming_enabled）
        - variant_params    : 可选，用于实验时覆盖策略（来自 Experiment Variant）
        """
        flags = runtime_flags or {}
        params = variant_params or {}

        degrade_mode = bool(flags.get("degrade_mode", False))
        cost_sensitive = bool(params.get("cost_sensitive", False))
        safety_sensitive = bool(params.get("safety_sensitive", False))

        # 1) 选择候选模型 ID（简单规则版）
        model_id = self._select_model_id(request, degrade_mode, cost_sensitive, safety_sensitive)
        provider = self._infer_provider_from_model_id(model_id)

        reason_parts = []
        if degrade_mode:
            reason_parts.append("degrade_mode")
        if cost_sensitive:
            reason_parts.append("cost_sensitive")
        if safety_sensitive:
            reason_parts.append("safety_sensitive")
        if not reason_parts:
            reason_parts.append("default_routing")

        decision = ModelRouteDecision(
            model_id=model_id,
            provider=provider,
            reason=",".join(reason_parts),
            params={
                "degrade_mode": degrade_mode,
                "cost_sensitive": cost_sensitive,
                "safety_sensitive": safety_sensitive,
            },
        )

        # v1: outcome 先留空，后续可以由调用者补上（成功率 / cost 等）
        outcome = ModelRouteOutcomeRecord()

        # 写日志（便于后续离线分析）
        try:
            req_record = request.to_record()
            dec_record = decision.to_record()
            self.log_store.append(
                request=req_record,
                decision=dec_record,
                outcome=outcome,
                runtime_flags=flags,
                experiment_tags=params.get("experiment_tags") or {},
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("ModelRouter.route: failed to log route record")

        return decision

    # --- 内部策略（v1：简单规则）--- #
    def _select_model_id(
        self,
        request: ModelRouteRequest,
        degrade_mode: bool,
        cost_sensitive: bool,
        safety_sensitive: bool,
    ) -> str:
        # 优先 degrade_mode：只用 safe_model
        if degrade_mode:
            return self.config.safe_model

        # 安全优先（例如 legal 域）
        if safety_sensitive or request.domain.lower() in ("legal", "compliance"):
            return self.config.safe_model

        # 成本优先
        if cost_sensitive or request.constraints.get("budget") == "low":
            return self._select_cheap_model(request)

        # 按 task_type 精细控制（如 planning/logging 等）
        if request.task_type in self.config.by_task_type:
            return self.config.by_task_type[request.task_type]

        # 按 domain 控制
        if request.domain in self.config.by_domain:
            return self.config.by_domain[request.domain]

        # 默认
        return self.config.default_model

    def _select_cheap_model(self, request: ModelRouteRequest) -> str:
        # v1：简单返回 cheap_model，后面可以根据 task_type / domain 做更细粒度策略
        return self.config.cheap_model

    def _infer_provider_from_model_id(self, model_id: str) -> str:
        """
        根据 model_id 推断 provider（只是示例逻辑）。
        例如：
        - "gpt-4o"         -> "openai"
        - "deepseek-r1"    -> "deepseek"
        - "qwen2.5:7b"     -> "ollama"
        """
        if "gpt" in model_id:
            return "openai"
        if "deepseek" in model_id:
            return "deepseek"
        if "qwen" in model_id or ":" in model_id:
            return "ollama"
        return "unknown"
后续自编程引擎可以通过修改 ModelRouterConfig.by_task_type/by_domain/extra 来“学会”更好的路由策略；
ModelRouterLogStore 里的 JSONL 文件，就是训练数据。

三、ModelRouter 的 ExperimentRunner：quentin/research/runners/model_router_offline_runner.py
借用我们已经实现的 EvalHarness，做一个离线评测 Runner。

# quentin/research/runners/model_router_offline_runner.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Callable
import logging

from quentin.research.orchestrator import ExperimentRunner
from quentin.research.experiments import (
    ExperimentConfig,
    VariantConfig,
    VariantResult,
)
from quentin.eval.spec import EvalDatasetSpec, EvalTaskSpec
from quentin.eval.harness import EvalHarness
from quentin.core.model_router import ModelRouter, ModelRouteRequest

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# eval_router_fn: (task, variant, context, router) -> {success, score, notes, ...}
EvalRouterFn = Callable[
    [EvalTaskSpec, VariantConfig, Dict[str, Any], ModelRouter],
    Dict[str, Any]
]


class ModelRouterOfflineRunner(ExperimentRunner):
    """
    针对 ModelRouter 的离线评测 Runner。

    用法：
    - context 里提供：
        - "router_base_config": 可选，初始化 ModelRouterConfig 用
        - "router_eval_dataset": EvalDatasetSpec（component="model_router"）
        - "eval_router_fn": 可选，自定义评测函数
    - 若未提供 eval_router_fn，则使用 stub 版本：
        - 如果 expected_output.expected_model_id 存在且与 router 选择一致 => score=1
        - 否则 score=0
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        eval_harness: Optional[EvalHarness] = None,
        eval_router_fn: Optional[EvalRouterFn] = None,
        repo_root: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.eval_harness = eval_harness or EvalHarness()
        self.eval_router_fn = eval_router_fn or self._stub_eval_router_fn
        self.repo_root = repo_root

    def run_variant(
        self,
        experiment: ExperimentConfig,
        variant: VariantConfig,
        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> VariantResult:
        ctx = dict(context or {})

        dataset: Optional[EvalDatasetSpec] = (
            ctx.get("router_eval_dataset")
            or ctx.get("eval_dataset")
        )
        if dataset is None:
            logger.warning(
                "ModelRouterOfflineRunner: no EvalDatasetSpec provided in context "
                "(router_eval_dataset / eval_dataset missing). Using empty dataset."
            )
            dataset = EvalDatasetSpec(
                dataset_id="empty_router",
                name="empty_router",
                description="Empty dataset for ModelRouter.",
                component="model_router",
                tasks=[],
            )

        if dataset.component != "model_router":
            logger.warning(
                "ModelRouterOfflineRunner: dataset.component=%s but runner is for model_router.",
                dataset.component,
            )

        base_cfg = ctx.get("router_base_config") or {}
        router = ModelRouter(
            repo_root=self.repo_root or ".",
            base_config=base_cfg,
        )

        def _eval_fn(task: EvalTaskSpec, variant_cfg: VariantConfig, local_ctx: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            return self.eval_router_fn(task, variant_cfg, local_ctx, router)

        return self.eval_harness.run_dataset(
            experiment=experiment,
            variant=variant,
            dataset=dataset,
            eval_fn=_eval_fn,
            context=ctx,
        )

    # ---------- 默认 stub 评测逻辑 ---------- #

    def _stub_eval_router_fn(
        self,
        task: EvalTaskSpec,
        variant: VariantConfig,
        context: Dict[str, Any],
        router: ModelRouter,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        stub 版评测逻辑：

        - 从 task.input_payload 中读取：
            - task_type
            - importance
            - domain
            - constraints
        - 从 expected_output 中读取 expected_model_id，如果 router 选的一致 => success=True, score=1。
        """
        ip = task.input_payload or {}
        req = ModelRouteRequest(
            task_type=ip.get("task_type", "generic"),
            importance=ip.get("importance", "normal"),
            domain=ip.get("domain", "general"),
            constraints=ip.get("constraints", {}),
            metadata=ip.get("metadata", {}),
        )

        # variant.params 作为 variant_params 传给 router（例如 cost_sensitive / safety_sensitive）
        decision = router.route(
            req,
            runtime_flags=context.get("runtime_flags") or {},
            variant_params=variant.params,
        )

        expected = task.expected_output or {}
        expected_model_id = expected.get("expected_model_id")

        success = (expected_model_id is not None and decision.model_id == expected_model_id)
        score = 1.0 if success else 0.0

        return {
            "success": success,
            "score": score,
            "notes": "stub router eval; replace with real scoring logic if needed.",
            "chosen_model_id": decision.model_id,
            "expected_model_id": expected_model_id,
            "variant_id": variant.variant_id,
            "task_id": task.task_id,
        }
后续你要做更高级的评测（例如结合质量评分、成本、延迟等），只需要把 eval_router_fn 换成自己的函数即可。

# quentin/skills/schema.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from datetime import datetime


@dataclass
class SkillStats:
    """
    Skill 的运行指标，由系统自动更新。
    """
    call_count: int = 0
    success_count: int = 0
    last_used_at: Optional[str] = None
    avg_latency_ms: float = 0.0
    avg_reward: float = 0.0  # 任务收益 / 评分等，可选

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class SkillTestCase:
    """
    Skill 的测试用例。
    注意：蓝皮书要求 test_cases 和 safety_level 需要人类创建 / 审核。
    """
    name: str
    description: str
    input_payload: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    expected_output: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    importance: str = "normal"      # "smoke" / "normal" / "critical"
    created_by: str = "human"
    created_at: str = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class SkillDefinition:
    """
    稳定的 Skill 定义，保存在 LTS/MTS 中。
    """
    skill_id: str                     # 全局唯一，如 "desktop.click_button"
    name: str                         # 人类可读名称
    version: int                      # 整数版本号
    description: str
    domain: str                       # "general" / "desktop" / "legal" / "trading" / ...
    entry_point: str                  # Python 路径，如 "quentin.skills.desktop.click_button:run"
    tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    created_at: str = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    created_by: str = "system"

    safety_level: str = "medium"      # "low" / "medium" / "high"
    status: str = "active"            # "active" / "deprecated" / "candidate" / "disabled"

    supersedes: Optional[str] = None  # 被替换的 skill_id 或 "skill_id@version"
    superseded_by: Optional[str] = None

    test_cases: List[SkillTestCase] = field(default_factory=list)
    performance_stats: SkillStats = field(default_factory=SkillStats)

    meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        return d


@dataclass
class SkillCandidate:
    """
    自演化过程中产生的 Skill 候选（还没正式变成 active Skill）。
    """
    candidate_id: str
    base_skill_id: Optional[str]      # 基于哪个现有 skill 改的，如 "desktop.click_button@3"
    proposed_skill: SkillDefinition   # 新 Skill 定义
    origin: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # 来源：trace id / immune_case_id / experiment_id 等
    status: str = "pending_eval"      # "pending_eval" / "evaluating" / "accepted" / "rejected"
    created_at: str = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    created_by: str = "self_programming_engine"

    notes: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class SkillSupersedesRecord:
    """
    用于记录旧 Skill 与新 Skill 的替换关系。
    """
    old_skill_ref: str                # 如 "desktop.click_button@3"
    new_skill_ref: str                # 如 "desktop.click_button@4"
    reason: str
    created_at: str = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    created_by: str = "self_programming_engine"
    meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)
2. quentin/skills/store.py
# quentin/skills/store.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from pathlib import Path
import json
import logging

from quentin.skills.schema import (
    SkillDefinition,
    SkillCandidate,
    SkillSupersedesRecord,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SkillStore:
    """
    v1: 基于文件系统的 Skill 存储。
    将来可替换为 DB / 对象存储。

    目录结构：
    - data/skills/definitions/{skill_id}.json
    - data/skills/candidates/{candidate_id}.json
    - data/skills/supersedes.jsonl
    """

    def __init__(self, *, repo_root: str | Path = ".") -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.base_dir = self.repo_root / "data" / "skills"
        self.base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.def_dir = self.base_dir / "definitions"
        self.def_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.cand_dir = self.base_dir / "candidates"
        self.cand_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.supersedes_path = self.base_dir / "supersedes.jsonl"

    # -------- SkillDefinition -------- #
    def save_skill(self, skill: SkillDefinition) -> None:
        path = self.def_dir / f"{skill.skill_id}.json"
        try:
            path.write_text(
                json.dumps(skill.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("SkillStore: failed to save skill %s", path)

    def load_skill(self, skill_id: str) -> Optional[SkillDefinition]:
        path = self.def_dir / f"{skill_id}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        try:
            obj = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            from quentin.skills.schema import SkillDefinition, SkillStats, SkillTestCase

            stats = SkillStats(**obj.get("performance_stats", {}))
            test_cases = [SkillTestCase(**tc) for tc in obj.get("test_cases", [])]
            return SkillDefinition(
                skill_id=obj["skill_id"],
                name=obj.get("name", ""),
                version=int(obj.get("version", 1)),
                description=obj.get("description", ""),
                domain=obj.get("domain", "general"),
                entry_point=obj.get("entry_point", ""),
                tags=obj.get("tags", []),
                created_at=obj.get("created_at", ""),
                created_by=obj.get("created_by", "system"),
                safety_level=obj.get("safety_level", "medium"),
                status=obj.get("status", "active"),
                supersedes=obj.get("supersedes"),
                superseded_by=obj.get("superseded_by"),
                test_cases=test_cases,
                performance_stats=stats,
                meta=obj.get("meta", {}),
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("SkillStore: failed to load skill %s", path)
            return None

    def list_skills(self) -> List[SkillDefinition]:
        skills: List[SkillDefinition] = []
        for path in self.def_dir.glob("*.json"):
            s = self.load_skill(path.stem)
            if s is not None:
                skills.append(s)
        return skills

    # -------- SkillCandidate -------- #
    def save_candidate(self, cand: SkillCandidate) -> None:
        path = self.cand_dir / f"{cand.candidate_id}.json"
        try:
            path.write_text(
                json.dumps(cand.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("SkillStore: failed to save candidate %s", path)

    def load_candidate(self, candidate_id: str) -> Optional[SkillCandidate]:
        path = self.cand_dir / f"{candidate_id}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        try:
            obj = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            from quentin.skills.schema import SkillDefinition

            sd = SkillDefinition(**obj["proposed_skill"])
            return SkillCandidate(
                candidate_id=obj["candidate_id"],
                base_skill_id=obj.get("base_skill_id"),
                proposed_skill=sd,
                origin=obj.get("origin", {}),
                status=obj.get("status", "pending_eval"),
                created_at=obj.get("created_at", ""),
                created_by=obj.get("created_by", "self_programming_engine"),
                notes=obj.get("notes", ""),
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("SkillStore: failed to load candidate %s", path)
            return None

    def list_candidates(self, status: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 100) -> List[SkillCandidate]:
        cands: List[SkillCandidate] = []
        for path in self.cand_dir.glob("*.json"):
            c = self.load_candidate(path.stem)
            if c is None:
                continue
            if status is not None and c.status != status:
                continue
            cands.append(c)
            if len(cands) >= limit:
                break
        return cands

    # -------- Supersedes -------- #
    def append_supersedes_record(self, rec: SkillSupersedesRecord) -> None:
        line = json.dumps(rec.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False)
        try:
            with self.supersedes_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(line + "\n")
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("SkillStore: failed to append supersedes record to %s", self.supersedes_path)

# quentin/self_programming/schema.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from datetime import datetime


@dataclass
class PatchTargetRef:
    """
    自编程引擎要修改的目标引用。

    target_type:
      - "skill"  : 针对某个 SkillDefinition（通常是 entry_point 里的函数）
      - "module" : 针对某个 Python 模块
    identifier:
      - 对于 "skill"  : skill_id 或 "skill_id@version"
      - 对于 "module": Python 模块路径，如 "quentin/core/model_router.py"
    """
    target_type: str
    identifier: str
    file_path: str
    symbol_name: Optional[str] = None   # 函数/类名，可选
    meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class PatchCandidate:
    """
    自编程引擎生成的 Patch 候选。

    patch_diff 使用 unified diff（字符串）或其它形式，v1 不强制。
    """
    patch_id: str
    target: PatchTargetRef
    description: str
    patch_diff: str                     # 统一 diff 或替代形式
    created_at: str = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    created_by: str = "self_programming_engine"
    origin: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)   # 如 immune_case_id / experiment_id / trace_id

    status: str = "pending_tests"       # "pending_tests" / "testing" / "tested" / "accepted" / "rejected"

    notes: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class PatchTestResult:
    """
    单个测试的结果。
    """
    test_name: str
    passed: bool
    details: str = ""
    metrics: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class PatchReport:
    """
    Patch 的整体评估结果。
    """
    patch_id: str
    status: str                         # "passed" / "failed" / "error"
    created_at: str = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()

    tests: List[PatchTestResult] = field(default_factory=list)
    coverage: float = 0.0               # 测试覆盖率（占位）
    risk_score: float = 1.0             # 0~1，越低越安全
    metrics_delta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # 如 success_rate 提升多少

    error: Optional[str] = None
    notes: str = ""
    origin: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)        # 如 {"experiment_id": "..."} 等

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

# quentin/self_programming/store.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json
import logging

from quentin.self_programming.schema import PatchCandidate, PatchReport

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PatchStore:
    """
    v1: Patch 候选和评估报告的文件存储。
    """

    def __init__(self, *, repo_root: str | Path = ".") -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.base_dir = self.repo_root / "data" / "patches"
        self.base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.cand_dir = self.base_dir / "candidates"
        self.cand_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.report_dir = self.base_dir / "reports"
        self.report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ----- Candidate ----- #
    def save_candidate(self, cand: PatchCandidate) -> None:
        path = self.cand_dir / f"{cand.patch_id}.json"
        try:
            path.write_text(
                json.dumps(cand.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("PatchStore: failed to save candidate %s", path)

    def load_candidate(self, patch_id: str) -> Optional[PatchCandidate]:
        path = self.cand_dir / f"{patch_id}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        try:
            obj = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            from quentin.self_programming.schema import PatchTargetRef, PatchCandidate

            target = PatchTargetRef(**obj["target"])
            return PatchCandidate(
                patch_id=obj["patch_id"],
                target=target,
                description=obj.get("description", ""),
                patch_diff=obj.get("patch_diff", ""),
                created_at=obj.get("created_at", ""),
                created_by=obj.get("created_by", "self_programming_engine"),
                origin=obj.get("origin", {}),
                status=obj.get("status", "pending_tests"),
                notes=obj.get("notes", ""),
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("PatchStore: failed to load candidate %s", path)
            return None

    def list_candidates(self, status: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 100) -> List[PatchCandidate]:
        cands: List[PatchCandidate] = []
        for path in self.cand_dir.glob("*.json"):
            c = self.load_candidate(path.stem)
            if c is None:
                continue
            if status is not None and c.status != status:
                continue
            cands.append(c)
            if len(cands) >= limit:
                break
        return cands

    # ----- Report ----- #
    def save_report(self, report: PatchReport) -> None:
        path = self.report_dir / f"{report.patch_id}.json"
        try:
            path.write_text(
                json.dumps(report.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("PatchStore: failed to save report %s", path)

    def load_report(self, patch_id: str) -> Optional[PatchReport]:
        path = self.report_dir / f"{patch_id}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        try:
            obj = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            from quentin.self_programming.schema import PatchReport, PatchTestResult

            tests = [PatchTestResult(**t) for t in obj.get("tests", [])]
            return PatchReport(
                patch_id=obj["patch_id"],
                status=obj.get("status", "failed"),
                created_at=obj.get("created_at", ""),
                tests=tests,
                coverage=float(obj.get("coverage", 0.0)),
                risk_score=float(obj.get("risk_score", 1.0)),
                metrics_delta=obj.get("metrics_delta", {}),
                error=obj.get("error"),
                notes=obj.get("notes", ""),
                origin=obj.get("origin", {}),
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("PatchStore: failed to load report %s", path)
            return None
三、自编程引擎骨架：quentin/self_programming/engine.py
# quentin/self_programming/engine.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Iterable
from pathlib import Path
import logging
import uuid

from quentin.skills.schema import SkillDefinition, SkillCandidate, SkillSupersedesRecord
from quentin.skills.store import SkillStore
from quentin.self_programming.schema import (
    PatchTargetRef,
    PatchCandidate,
    PatchReport,
    PatchTestResult,
)
from quentin.self_programming.store import PatchStore
from quentin.research.experiments import ExperimentStore, ExperimentConfig, VariantConfig
from quentin.research.orchestrator import ExperimentOrchestrator

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SelfProgrammingEngine:
    """
    自编程引擎 v1 骨架：

    职责：
    1. 接收“需要改进的模块 / Skill 列表”（来自 ImmuneLoop / ResearchLayer）
    2. 生成 SkillCandidate / PatchCandidate（调用 LLM，v1 留 TODO）
    3. 调度测试 & 评测（对 PatchCandidate / SkillCandidate 跑单测 / 回归 / Eval）
    4. 输出 PatchReport / SupersedesRecord，供 ResearchLayer 决定是否上线

    注意：
    - 不允许修改 kernel / schema / 风控等区域；
    - 仅操作明确标记为“可自动更新”的目标模块。
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: str | Path = ".",
        skill_store: Optional[SkillStore] = None,
        patch_store: Optional[PatchStore] = None,
        experiment_store: Optional[ExperimentStore] = None,
        experiment_orchestrator: Optional[ExperimentOrchestrator] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.skill_store = skill_store or SkillStore(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.patch_store = patch_store or PatchStore(repo_root=self.repo_root)

        self.experiment_store = experiment_store or ExperimentStore(repo_root=self.repo_root)
        self.orchestrator = experiment_orchestrator or ExperimentOrchestrator(
            repo_root=self.repo_root,
            store=self.experiment_store,
        )

        # 维护一个“允许自动更新”的 target 白名单
        self.mutable_targets: List[PatchTargetRef] = []

    # ---------- 边界 & 注册 ---------- #
    def register_mutable_target(self, target: PatchTargetRef) -> None:
        """
        注册一个允许自动修改的目标。
        比如：
        - Desktop 域的工具模块
        - 非关键路径的 helper 函数
        """
        self.mutable_targets.append(target)

    def is_target_allowed(self, target: PatchTargetRef) -> bool:
        """
        核心安全边界：
        - 禁止修改 kernel / schema / 风控 / 交易执行模块
        - 只允许在 mutable 或特定白名单内
        """
        # 1) 简单规则：禁止 kernel、schema、risk
        forbidden_prefixes = [
            "quentin/kernel/",
            "quentin/core/safety_kernel",
            "quentin/core/risk",
            "quentin/schema/",
        ]
        fp = str(target.file_path)
        for pref in forbidden_prefixes:
            if fp.replace("\\", "/").startswith(pref):
                return False

        # 2) 必须在 mutable_targets 或 target_type="skill"
        if target.target_type == "skill":
            return True

        for t in self.mutable_targets:
            if t.target_type == target.target_type and t.identifier == target.identifier:
                return True

        return False

    # ---------- Skill Candidate 生成 ---------- #
    def propose_skill_candidate_from_trace(
        self,
        *,
        base_skill: Optional[SkillDefinition],
        trace_snippet: Dict[str, Any],
        origin: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> SkillCandidate:
        """
        从成功 Trace 中挖掘一个 Skill 候选（v1: 留 TODO，先返回 stub）。

        未来逻辑：
        - 用 LLM 分析 trace_snippet（多次成功的步骤模式）
        - 归纳为一个通用 Skill
        - 自动生成代码 & 初始测试用例
        """

        candidate_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
        if base_skill is not None:
            skill_id = base_skill.skill_id
            version = base_skill.version + 1
            name = base_skill.name + " (auto v%d)" % version
            domain = base_skill.domain
        else:
            # 完全新 Skill
            skill_id = "auto.skill." + candidate_id[:8]
            version = 1
            name = f"Auto Skill {candidate_id[:8]}"
            domain = trace_snippet.get("domain", "general")

        proposed = SkillDefinition(
            skill_id=skill_id,
            name=name,
            version=version,
            description="Auto-generated skill candidate from trace.",
            domain=domain,
            entry_point="quentin.skills.auto.%s:run" % candidate_id[:8],
            tags=["auto_generated", "from_trace"],
            created_by="self_programming_engine",
            safety_level=base_skill.safety_level if base_skill else "medium",
            status="candidate",
        )

        cand = SkillCandidate(
            candidate_id=candidate_id,
            base_skill_id=f"{base_skill.skill_id}@{base_skill.version}" if base_skill else None,
            proposed_skill=proposed,
            origin=origin,
            status="pending_eval",
            notes="TODO: fill with real code & tests using LLM.",
        )

        self.skill_store.save_candidate(cand)
        return cand

    # ---------- Patch Candidate 生成 ---------- #
    def propose_patch_candidate(
        self,
        *,
        target: PatchTargetRef,
        issue_summary: Dict[str, Any],
        origin: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> Optional[PatchCandidate]:
        """
        根据 ImmuneCase / metrics 等，为某个目标生成 Patch 候选（stub）。

        v1 仅做占位：生成一个“空 Patch”，真正 diff 由后续 LLM 填充。
        """
        if not self.is_target_allowed(target):
            logger.warning(
                "SelfProgrammingEngine: target not allowed for auto patch: %s",
                target.to_dict(),
            )
            return None

        patch_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
        description = (
            f"Auto patch candidate for {target.identifier}, "
            f"reason={issue_summary.get('reason', 'unknown')}"
        )

        # v1: patch_diff 留空或写 TODO。后续可以让 LLM 根据现有代码 + issue 生成。
        patch = PatchCandidate(
            patch_id=patch_id,
            target=target,
            description=description,
            patch_diff="# TODO: auto-generated patch diff goes here\n",
            origin=origin,
            status="pending_tests",
        )
        self.patch_store.save_candidate(patch)
        return patch

    # ---------- Patch 测试 & 报告 ---------- #
    def run_tests_for_patch(
        self,
        patch: PatchCandidate,
        *,
        test_suites: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        extra_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> PatchReport:
        """
        在 Sandbox 环境跑 patch 的测试（v1 stub）。

        未来逻辑：
        - 在临时工作目录中 apply patch_diff
        - 运行 pytest / 静态分析 / fuzz / EvalHarness 等
        - 收集测试结果和指标
        """
        tests = test_suites or ["unit", "static_analysis"]
        results: List[PatchTestResult] = []

        # v1: 全部标记为未执行，提醒后续补
        for tname in tests:
            results.append(
                PatchTestResult(
                    test_name=tname,
                    passed=False,
                    details="Test not implemented; this is a stub.",
                    metrics={},
                )
            )

        report = PatchReport(
            patch_id=patch.patch_id,
            status="failed",   # 因为没有真正测试
            tests=results,
            coverage=0.0,
            risk_score=1.0,
            metrics_delta={},
            error="Tests not implemented (stub).",
            notes="SelfProgrammingEngine.run_tests_for_patch is not yet implemented.",
            origin=extra_context or {},
        )
        self.patch_store.save_report(report)
        return report

    # ---------- 评估 & 选择 ---------- #
    def select_patches_to_promote(
        self,
        reports: Iterable[PatchReport],
        *,
        max_promote: int = 1,
    ) -> List[PatchReport]:
        """
        根据 PatchReport 选择适合进一步进入 Staging / Canary 的 Patch。
        v1 简单规则：status == "passed" 且 risk_score <= 0.4。
        """
        candidates: List[PatchReport] = []
        for r in reports:
            if r.status == "passed" and r.risk_score <= 0.4:
                candidates.append(r)

        # 简单按 risk_score 排序
        candidates.sort(key=lambda r: r.risk_score)
        return candidates[:max_promote]

    # ---------- 应用 Skill Candidate ---------- #
    def accept_skill_candidate(
        self,
        cand: SkillCandidate,
        *,
        reason: str,
    ) -> SkillSupersedesRecord:
        """
        将 SkillCandidate 变成正式 Skill，并记录 supersedes 关系。
        注意：真正的“代码替换”仍需部署系统 / 人类 Gate。
        """
        skill = cand.proposed_skill
        base_ref = cand.base_skill_id

        # 更新 skill 状态并保存
        skill.status = "active"
        self.skill_store.save_skill(skill)

        # 更新 candidate 状态
        cand.status = "accepted"
        self.skill_store.save_candidate(cand)

        # 记录 supersedes
        if base_ref:
            rec = SkillSupersedesRecord(
                old_skill_ref=base_ref,
                new_skill_ref=f"{skill.skill_id}@{skill.version}",
                reason=reason,
                created_by="self_programming_engine",
                meta={"candidate_id": cand.candidate_id},
            )
            self.skill_store.append_supersedes_record(rec)
        else:
            rec = SkillSupersedesRecord(
                old_skill_ref="",
                new_skill_ref=f"{skill.skill_id}@{skill.version}",
                reason=reason,
                created_by="self_programming_engine",
                meta={"candidate_id": cand.candidate_id},
            )
            self.skill_store.append_supersedes_record(rec)

        return rec
这里我们没有直接连接 ExperimentOrchestrator 做自动实验，只是预留了 self.orchestrator 成员。

四、Skill & Code Evolution Loop 骨架：quentin/evolution/skill_loop.py
# quentin/evolution/skill_loop.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
import logging

from quentin.self_programming.engine import SelfProgrammingEngine
from quentin.self_programming.schema import PatchTargetRef, PatchCandidate, PatchReport
from quentin.skills.schema import SkillDefinition, SkillCandidate

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SkillEvolutionLoop:
    """
    Skill & Code Evolution Loop v1 骨架（对应蓝皮书 3.4）：

    输入：
    - 高成功率 Trace（来自 CognitiveLoop / TraceStore）
    - ImmuneCase（表现差的模块 / Skill）
    - MetaLayer/Research 提供的“需要重点优化的组件列表”

    输出：
    - 新 SkillCandidate（从成功模式中抽取）
    - PatchCandidate（针对问题模块生成）
    - PatchReport（测试和评估结果）
    - SupersedesRecord（替换旧 Skill）

    v1：只提供结构和关键方法调用，内部逻辑先留 TODO。
    """

    def __init__(self, engine: SelfProgrammingEngine) -> None:
        self.engine = engine

    # ---- 从成功 Trace 中抽取 Skill ---- #
    def mine_skills_from_traces(
        self,
        successful_traces: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> List[SkillCandidate]:
        """
        根据高成功率 Trace 生成一批 SkillCandidate（stub）。
        真实实现可以使用：
        - pattern mining
        - LLM 对 Trace 的 summary + 抽象
        """
        candidates: List[SkillCandidate] = []

        for tr in successful_traces:
            # v1: 只针对标记为 "skill_seed": true 的 trace，避免乱生成
            if not tr.get("skill_seed"):
                continue
            base_skill: Optional[SkillDefinition] = None
            origin = {
                "type": "trace",
                "trace_id": tr.get("trace_id"),
            }
            cand = self.engine.propose_skill_candidate_from_trace(
                base_skill=base_skill,
                trace_snippet=tr,
                origin=origin,
            )
            candidates.append(cand)

        return candidates

    # ---- 从 ImmuneCase 生成 Patch ---- #
    def generate_patches_from_issues(
        self,
        issue_list: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> List[PatchCandidate]:
        """
        issue_list 典型来源：
        - ImmuneCase（高失败率模块）
        - ResearchLayer 标记的 "需要优化的工具"
        """
        patches: List[PatchCandidate] = []

        for issue in issue_list:
            target_info = issue.get("target") or {}
            target = PatchTargetRef(
                target_type=target_info.get("target_type", "module"),
                identifier=target_info.get("identifier", ""),
                file_path=target_info.get("file_path", ""),
                symbol_name=target_info.get("symbol_name"),
                meta=target_info.get("meta", {}),
            )
            origin = {
                "type": "issue",
                "issue_id": issue.get("issue_id"),
                "source": issue.get("source", "immune"),
            }
            issue_summary = {
                "reason": issue.get("reason", ""),
                "metrics": issue.get("metrics", {}),
            }
            cand = self.engine.propose_patch_candidate(
                target=target,
                issue_summary=issue_summary,
                origin=origin,
            )
            if cand is not None:
                patches.append(cand)

        return patches

    # ---- 测试 Patch 并生成 Report ---- #
    def evaluate_patches(
        self,
        patches: List[PatchCandidate],
        *,
        test_suites: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        extra_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> List[PatchReport]:
        """
        遍历 PatchCandidate，调用 SelfProgrammingEngine.run_tests_for_patch。
        v1: 仍然是 stub 测试。
        """
        reports: List[PatchReport] = []
        for p in patches:
            report = self.engine.run_tests_for_patch(
                patch=p,
                test_suites=test_suites,
                extra_context=extra_context,
            )
            reports.append(report)
        return reports

    # ---- 顶层 run_once：单次演化轮次 ---- #
    def run_once(
        self,
        *,
        successful_traces: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        issues: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        test_suites: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        extra_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        一次完整的演化轮次（可由 SleepLoop / ResearchLayer 触发）：

        1. 从成功 Trace 抽取 SkillCandidate
        2. 从 Immune issue 生成 PatchCandidate
        3. 对 Patch 进行测试 & 生成 PatchReport
        4. 根据 PatchReport 选出少量“值得推进”的 Patch（当前只返回，真正上线仍需上层决策）
        """
        logger.info(
            "SkillEvolutionLoop.run_once: traces=%d issues=%d",
            len(successful_traces),
            len(issues),
        )

        skill_candidates = self.mine_skills_from_traces(successful_traces)
        patch_candidates = self.generate_patches_from_issues(issues)
        patch_reports = self.evaluate_patches(
            patch_candidates,
            test_suites=test_suites,
            extra_context=extra_context,
        )

        # 根据报告选择“可推进”的 patch（进入 Staging / Canary）
        promotable = self.engine.select_patches_to_promote(patch_reports, max_promote=extra_context.get("max_promote", 1) if extra_context else 1)

        return {
            "skill_candidates": [c.to_dict() for c in skill_candidates],
            "patch_candidates": [p.to_dict() for p in patch_candidates],
            "patch_reports": [r.to_dict() for r in patch_reports],
            "promotable_patches": [r.to_dict() for r in promotable],
        }
接下来只需要一个调度点（比如 SleepLoop）定期调用 SkillEvolutionLoop.run_once(...)，
就形成了：“执行 → Immune 标记问题 → Research / Sleep 调用演化 → 生成候选 → 等待 Gate / 宪法层审批”的闭环。

五：这一步和蓝皮书的对齐情况
对应 v3 蓝皮书中的部分：

3.4 技能与代码进化循环（Skill & Code Evolution Loop）

✅ 输入：

successful_traces（高成功率 trace，占位结构）

issues（来自 Immune / Research 标记的坏模块）

✅ 步骤骨架：

mine_skills_from_traces → SkillCandidate

generate_patches_from_issues → PatchCandidate

evaluate_patches → PatchReport

select_patches_to_promote → 推荐少量 patch 进入 Staging/Canary

✅ 输出：

skill_candidates / patch_candidates / patch_reports / promotable_patches

4 自编程引擎（Self-Programming Engine）

✅ 结构化定义：

PatchTargetRef / PatchCandidate / PatchReport

SkillCandidate / SkillSupersedesRecord

✅ 引擎职责骨架：

propose_skill_candidate_from_trace（从 trace 抽技能候选）

propose_patch_candidate（针对目标生成 patch 候选）

run_tests_for_patch（在 Sandbox 跑测试，当前为 stub）

select_patches_to_promote（根据报告选 patch）

accept_skill_candidate（接纳 skill 候选 + 记录 supersedes）

✅ 边界：

is_target_allowed 明确禁止 kernel / schema / 风控等路径

只对标记为 mutable 的模块做自动 patch

Research-Friendly & 实验接口

SelfProgrammingEngine 内部已注入 ExperimentOrchestrator / ExperimentStore 成员，
方便下一步直接挂：create_experiment_for_patch/skill → 用 EvalHarness + Runner 做系统化评测。
